title: MSc/Phd Data Scientists & Engineers (OIP Program)
description:
OIP Program - RAIMS®
100-Day Supervised Work Experience and Training Program — MSc/PhD Graduates

Tracks: 1) EXTRACT 2) CUSTOMIZE 3) LOAD
Program: Orcawise Innovation Program (OIP)
Focus: Development of RAIMS™ (Responsible AI Management System)

About the Program

The Orcawise Innovation Program (OIP) is a 100-day research and build work experience program designed for MSc and PhD graduates looking to transition to a career in Responsible AI Management Systems (RAIMS)

If successful, you’ll join a small, high-impact cohort working on the development of RAIMS™ - the world’s first operational framework for responsible AI governance, aligned with ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act. Your work will be applied directly to the internal tooling, standards, and systems behind RAIMS.chat and the broader Orcawise ecosystem.

Tracks You Can Join:

1. EXTRACT – Data Grounding for Trust

You’ll build the trusted data layer for RAIMS:

  • Source legally usable knowledge (laws, standards, docs)
  • Ingest and process PDFs, HTML, CSVs
  • Chunk, tag, and store content in a structured vector database
  • Design gold-standard test sets and evidence-verified answers
  • Evaluate grounding precision and citation fidelity

Outcome: A well-indexed, evaluable RAG pipeline that powers explainable answers in RAIMS.chat.

2. CUSTOMIZE – Custom LLM, Prompt & Behavior Engineering

You’ll design and test prompt behaviors under governance constraints:

  • Create role-based system and user prompts with embedded metadata
  • Apply advanced reasoning frameworks (ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, etc.)
  • Implement safety refusals, guardrails, and content moderation logic
  • Compare in-context learning vs. fine-tuning and example stores
  • Optimize for accuracy, consistency, and governance traceability

Outcome: A catalog of prompts, templates, and control strategies aligned with RAIMS principles.

3. LOAD – Deploy & Govern RAIMS.chat

You’ll build the RAIMS.chat agent interface and operations layer:

  • Develop chat UI (persona selector, streaming, citations, feedback)
  • Implement agent orchestration using functions, extensions, and RAG
  • Log prompt metadata, cost, latency, and risk flags
  • Build audit-export features and RBAC/SSO login
  • Ensure traceability, fallback logic, and real-time observability

Outcome: A working prototype of RAIMS.chat with full governance tracking and compliance readiness.

What You’ll Do (All Tracks)

  • Scope and deliver a 100-day project with real-world impact
  • Produce a demo + governance pack (logs, risks, tests)
  • Track performance (accuracy, safety, latency, cost)
  • Document decisions, architectures, and learning outcomes
  • Share insights through a summary blog or lightning talk

Who We’re Looking For

Required

  • MSc or PhD (or near completion) in: AI, Data Science, Law+Tech, IS, HCI, Statistics, Engineering, or Policy O
  • Solid Python (data workflows, scripting, basic API usage)
  • Strong writing and documentation skills
  • Comfortable with experimentation, iteration, and self-direction

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, LangChain or similar
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases
  • Interest in Responsible AI, ISO 42001, or the EU AI Act
  • Cloud experience (GCP/AWS), front-end frameworks (for LOAD)

Program Milestones - How it Works
The OIP is running constantly with daily training sessions and work experience schedules. Join the community and log into the daily track sessions where you will be expected to hit the ground running for a demanding work experience.

What You’ll Gain

  • OIP Verified - Certificate of Completion verifying 100-days work experience
  • RAIMS® Certified: AI Systems Architect
  • Experience designing responsible AI systems in production
  • Deep understanding of RAIMS™, ISO 42001, and regulatory-aligned prompt engineering
  • Daily mentorship from Orcawise engineers, governance leads, and researchers
  • A real-world project you can showcase as part of your portfolio or thesis
  • Public credit (optional) for your contribution via blog/talk/demo

Application question(s):

  • Can you commit a minimum of 20-hours per week to a 100-day work experience program focused on RAIM® (Responsible AI Management System) ?

Education:

  • Master's (preferred)

Work Location: Remote

title: Junior Cybersecurity Consultant
description:
Location: Dublin 3

Ergo are seeking a Junior Cybersecurity Consultant to join our market-leading Cybersecurity Team in a hybrid role based at our Eastpoint offices in Dublin 3.   • Advise on appropriate security tooling solutions.
  • Flexibility to travel to project sites, industry events, and trade shows as required.

  • Comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS and associated regulations/directives such as NIS2, DORA, AI Act & GDPR.
  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills, enabling thorough evaluation of complex data and development of effective policies.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration capabilities and the ability to manage relationships effectively.


Experience:

  • Experience using a ticketing or ITSM system (for example ServiceNow or similar).
  • Experience supporting Penetration testing activities and providing remediation guidance.
  • Experience working with compliance frameworks and security governance initiatives.


Education & Certifications:

  • Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or an equivalent IT-related discipline.
  • Relevant industry certifications considered advantageous.


Visa:

  • Irish/EU Citizen or Stamp 4 Visa holder.


About Us
As Ireland's largest IT Solutions Provider with a growing global footprint, Ergo offers deep expertise across managed IT & hardware services, cloud, applications & software services, IT resourcing, and modern work solutions. Our recent technology awards reflect our commitment to delivering industry-leading IT solutions, highlighting our team's dedication and expertise.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity.

We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

The Role

As our QA Engineer, you will be the guardian of excellence within our Agile squads, shifting quality "to the left" to ensure we ship world-class software at speed. Your mission is to bridge the gap between business requirements and seamless user experiences by building a robust, automated safety net for our Web and Mobile platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Quality Strategy: Collaborate with Product Owners during refinement to define robust Acceptance Criteria (AC) and identify edge cases before a single line of code is written.

  • Build Scalable Automation: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality automated test frameworks using Cypress (Web) and Maestro (Mobile).

  • Eliminate Bottlenecks: Implement and manage automated regression suites within our CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast, reliable releases.

  • Technical Mentorship: Act as a reference point for junior profiles, fostering a "Quality is everyone's responsibility" mindset across the engineering team.

  • End-to-End Validation: Perform API testing (Postman/Swagger) and database validation to ensure data integrity across our entire SaaS ecosystem.

  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify process gaps and propose modern QA tooling to elevate the technical standard of the organization.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing (STLC) with a strong focus on both Web and Mobile applications.

  • Automation Mastery: Proven expertise in building frameworks from scratch using Cypress (JS/TS); experience with Maestro or similar mobile tools is a major plus.

  • Agile Native: Experience working in Scrum squads, actively contributing to ceremonies and "Shift-Left" testing practices.

  • Technical Toolkit: Proficiency with Git, CI/CD tools (Jenkins/Azure DevOps/Docker), and SQL for data verification.

Good to have

  • Experience in the Travel, Tech or Telco industry.

  • Background in performance and/or security testing.

Hybrid Modality

We focus on trust and performance. We are implementing a Two phased approach for our Hybrid Modality:

Phase 1: While the teams are establishing ways of working, building trust, and developing their rhythm, we ask that you’re present in the office Three days a week. In-person proximity is key to accelerating the forming stage.

Phase 2: Once teams are performing, we move to a more relaxed hybrid model. We ask for a minimum of one day per week in the office, centred around critical ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Benefits & Perks

  • 25 Days of PTO

  • 5% pension contribution

  • € 3000 for Medical/Health coverage

  • Self development budget of $ 500

description:

job type: Fixed term / Full-time

Graduate and Intern Engineers (All Disciplines)


Overview –


The Engineering Co-Op student will support the project engineering team in the design, procurement, and site support activities associated with power-generation and industrial EPC projects.


This placement provides structured exposure to engineering design workflows, construction activities, geotechnical interpretation, vendor engagement, and multi-disciplinary coordination within a professional engineering environment.


The programme is designed in accordance with Engineers Ireland’s expectations for undergraduate professional formation, emphasising mentored learning, the development of core technical competencies, and the growth of professional skills, ethics, teamwork, and communication required for future progression toward graduate membership and chartership pathways.


Responsibilities

General Characteristics:


  • Gain practical experience applying engineering principles in a professional environment.
  • Work under close supervision while developing independence as appropriate.
  • Demonstrate professional conduct, teamwork, and a willingness to learn.
  • Develop awareness of safety, environmental responsibilities, and ethical practice.
  • Communicate clearly with engineering and construction teams


Technical Responsibilities

Under supervision, the student will assist with:


  • Collecting and organising project data (drawings, reports, surveys, specifications).
  • Basic calculations and design tasks such as levels, volumes, quantities, and simple checks.
  • Preparing and updating drawings or mark-ups using CAD tools.
  • Reviewing vendor drawings, reports, and EOR design packages.
  • Supporting preparation of technical submittals and tender inputs.
  • Participating in field investigations, testing, or construction observations.
  • Raising and tracking basic technical queries (RFIs) under guidance.


These tasks support the development of technical knowledge, problem-solving, and analytical skills promoted by Engineers Ireland.


Project, Programme & Task Support

The Co-Op student will:


  • Assist with the organisation of documents, registers, and project deliverables.
  • Support schedule tracking, progress reporting, and quantity take-offs.
  • Contribute to tender inputs (BOQs, estimates, layout support) under direction.
  • Coordinate small tasks with other team members and disciplines.


This develops an understanding of project delivery, planning, quality processes, and multidisciplinary interaction.


Supervision, Mentorship & Learning:


  • Receive daily guidance from assigned engineers and mentors.
  • Participate in technical reviews, team meetings, and site visits as appropriate.
  • Learn standard engineering procedures, codes, and design tools.
  • Gain awareness of professional responsibilities and progression toward Engineers Ireland graduate membership.


This supports the professional development and competence-building expected from an accredited Co-Op placement.


Construction & Site Support

Depending on project needs, the student may:


  • Visit or be based on the project sites to observe construction and installation works, QA/QC procedures, and safety practices.
  • Assist site engineers with measurements, progress checks, or documentation.
  • Learn construction sequencing, temporary works concepts, and practical buildability considerations.


This enhances understanding of how design translates to construction, a key requirement of Engineers Ireland.


Procurement & Vendor Interface

With supervision, the student may:


  • Review vendor information for completeness.
  • Support technical evaluations and documentation coordination.
  • Assist in tracking deliverables from suppliers and subcontractors.


This builds early experience in procurement, vendor management, and commercial awareness.

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality (HSEQ)


The student will:


  • Follow all safety, quality, and environmental procedures.
  • Participate in toolbox talks, inductions, and risk-awareness briefings.
  • Support quality documentation such as checks, redlines, and revisions.
  • Develop an understanding of safe design and construction practices.


These align with Engineers Ireland’s emphasis on ethics, safety, and professional responsibility.

Communication, Teamwork & Professionalism


The student will:


  • Prepare clear notes, emails, sketches, and basic reports.
  • Participate in team meetings and share updates on assigned tasks.
  • Work effectively with multi-discipline engineering and construction teams.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and respect in all interactions.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

AECOM are seeking a Graduate Ecologist in our Dublin Office to join us from June 2026.

About our Team

Ecology is part of AECOM’s Environment business (one of the leading environmental consultancies in the UK and Ireland) which delivers environmental management services for feasibility, impact analysis and operational compliance as well as remediation, restoration and re-use of impacted property. More than160 professional ecologists support AECOM’s goal to deliver a better world through effective management of the biodiversity that underpins natural capital.

We work across terrestrial, freshwater and marine environments in a wide range of sectors: power; utilities; development; government; manufacturing; oil and gas; and transportation. title: Business Administration - Management Trainee Programme

WHO WE ARE

We look for exceptional interpersonal skills, communication skills, and problem-solving abilities, plus the passion for technical excellence and quality. We seek individuals with leadership potential, a commitment to lifelong learning and growth, and the desire to build a long and rewarding career with a growing firm.

State Street will offer salary and benefits commensurate with State Street pay scales and experience.

description:
About the Business: LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner for risk assessment. Within our Insurance business, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance lifecycle, all while reducing risk and optimising processes. About our Team: The Data Science Rotational Programme will last 18 months and upon completion you will move full time into one of our core data science teams. About the Role: We are looking for a Graduate Data Scientist to conduct statistical analysis and build predictive models for insurance pricing, underwriting and fraud risk.   • Building and testing insurance pricing, underwriting and fraud risk statistical models, consulting in support of existing and new customer sales

  • Providing technical support and be a resource to internal partners in Product, Sales and Technology teams

  • Researching new technologies and bring forward new ideas to the group

Requirements

  • Have BSc. or MSc. degree in computer science, actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or quantitative methods (or equivalent experience).

  • Have good understanding of statistical methods applied to data analysis

  • Have understanding of various statistical methodologies including linear regression, logistic regression, and other advanced analytic techniques

  • Have good written communication skills, including the ability to describe statistical results to non-statistical audiences.

title: Laboratory Technician
description:

Technician

Closing Date: 03/06/2026 12:00 PM

Permanent Full Time



Job Summary

Post Type: Permanent Full Time.

Background:

Grange is part of the Animal & Grassland Research and Innovation Centre (AGRIC) in Teagasc and has extensive facilities for field and laboratory research. Teagasc has an international reputation for researching and developing grass-based systems of livestock production. The appointee will work with a dynamic team of researchers, technologists, technicians, farm staff, students and specialists at Grange.

title: S&I Graduate
description:
Your recipe for a rewarding career starts here!

About Us

Established in 1985, Dawn Farms is a family-owned company and the largest dedicated supplier of cooked meat and plant-based ingredients and fermented and dried sausage products outside of the US. The company currently supplies world-leading food brands across more than 44 markets, including the UK, Europe, Asia and Africa. With over 1,000 employees we are committed to meeting the needs of our customers in a safe, innovative and sustainable way, all while strengthening the communities where they live and work.

Job Purpose

Dawn Farms is currently seeking an S&I Graduate to join our Science & Innovation Department to be based in our state of the art production facilities in Naas, Co. Kildare. The Science & Innovation (S&I) Graduate will play a key role in planning and testing new ideas, contributing to the growth of the business across different innovation platforms and markets. This position offers exposure to state-of-the-art food research and manufacturing, as well as diverse protein product development and applications. Candidates will work in a team environment and are expected to have a passion for science and technology, with knowledge in Chemistry, Nutrition, Process Engineering, and Food Science. This multidisciplinary role involves learning new techniques, conducting practical experiments/trials, and handling multiple assignments within the S&I team.

Positions: Full-Time, Fixed Term 2 years.

Location: Naas, Co. Kildare, Ireland.

Salary: DOE

Working Hours: 39 hours per week, Mon. - Fri. (some flexibility required)

Role Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Plan and execute practical experiments and trials, designing and testing new or improved methods and products in the S&I Pure Culinary Science kitchen, pilot plant, or factories,
  • Collaborate closely with experienced Project Managers, advising on trial design, timelines, potential hurdles, and improvements to achieve technical advances.
  • Generate and interpret data, maintain SharePoint databases, and document results in OneNote and other Microsoft suite applications.
  • Present data and results effectively to the S&I team to drive decisions during the experimental and prototype testing phase.
  • Evaluate new ingredients, materials, products, or processes to build S&I capabilities.
  • Develop expertise in process and analytical methodologies, preparing and updating specifications and SOPs.
  • Capture key learnings and feedback to share within internal communications, improving our innovation process.
  • Coordinate trial planning and knowledge transfer within the team.
  • Work with cross-functional departments to execute collaborative project tasks.
  • Provide scientific and technical guidance to other team members and departments as needed.
  • Ensure food safety and adhere to health and safety policies, standard operating procedures, and good hygiene practices.

Key Deliverables:

  • Execution of practical trials, ensuring they are completed in a timely manner and based on the given brief.
  • Update trial reports and communication platforms daily.
  • Generation of high-quality reports and documentation, stored on SharePoint and OneNote.
  • Completion and review of trial reports and products with Project Managers.
  • Push projects to the next stage.
  • Achieve technical advances during trials.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, Food Fermentation, or related field.
  • General understanding of food applications and processing.
  • Excellent record-keeping and organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to read, collect, analyse, and interpret technical information and data.
  • Logical and scientific thinking applied to a wide range of problems.
  • Ability to operate standard laboratory and pilot equipment following training.
  • Troubleshooting skills are key to this role, and the candidate should be highly motivated and eager to learn.
  • Project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple activities simultaneously.
  • Ability to distinguish colours and flavours.
  • Understanding of GMP and Food Safety concepts.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in mathematical concepts such as percent, ppm, and basic algebraic equations.
  • Ability to build constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.
  • Willingness to travel as required.
  • Regularly required to lift and/or move materials or equipment up to 10kg and occasionally up to 20kg.

Why Dawn Farms?

We can offer an excellent opportunity to be part of a world-class team, equipping our teams with the knowledge and the necessary skills to achieve their full potential. Innovation is a key ingredient of our success in protecting our market position and keeping our competitive edge. To be truly innovative, we invest in recruiting and developing a highly skilled, ambitious and talented team.

What we can offer you?

  • 22 Days Annual Leave.
  • Health Insurance Contribution.
  • Pension Plan.
  • Subsided Canteen.
  • Training and Development Opportunities for further career progression.
  • Employee Assistance Programme (Free access/support to Life Coachs, Dietitians, Work Relocation advice etc.)
  • Bike to Work Scheme.
  • Christmas savings scheme.

title: QA Officer (a.i.)

SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company and is recognised as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With over 98,500 employees operating from more than 2,500 locations worldwide, SGS delivers trusted solutions across a wide range of industries, including pharmaceuticals and life sciences.

In Ireland, SGS provides analytical and technical services to the pharmaceutical sector through multiple laboratory locations. In 2021, SGS acquired International Services Laboratory (ISL) in Ringaskiddy, Cork, further strengthening its capabilities in pharmaceutical testing, including method development and transfer, release and stability testing, stability programme management, and scientific insourcing services.

At SGS, our work supports the safety and quality of medicines supplied to patients globally. We are committed to maintaining high technical and regulatory standards while supporting the professional development and wellbeing of our people.

We are looking for a experienced QA Officer to Manage major projects within our ISL Labs. As a member of the central quality team, own and oversee certain ISL Quality Management Systems. Act as Subject
Matter Expert for certain quality systems, providing ownership of effectiveness and compliance and providing guidance and coaching on their implementation. Maintain and improve quality compliance, working independently, but aligning with QA team lead. Support audit readiness and execution.

  • Liaise with Unit Coordinators/IT to minimise disruption caused by instrument downtime
  • Oversee the implementation of the Quality Manual and the ISL Quality Plan
  • Oversee Quality Risk Management on Site and provide guidance on its application

  • Maintain approved list of service providers

  • Site eCompliance Manager, reviewing and approving CSV documents and maintaining oversight on completion of user access reviews and periodic reviews

General Quality Processes & Documentation

  • Ensure changes are raised where appropriate and review/ approve

  • Look beyond ISL to define and resolve complex issues - Benchmark and liaise with other SGS labs to enhance performance


General


  • Deputise for QA Team Lead and QA Facilitator if required
  • Ensure all relevant training is maintained & up to date

Qualifications

    • Professional Practice
    • Communication and relationship building

Candidates will be required to describe in no more than 300 words per competency some of their personal achievements to-date that demonstrate the key competencies required for the position as outlined. Professional Knowledge

Indicators include:

  • Has a strong knowledge of subject matter.

  • Keeps up to date with subject matter/course syllabus changes and developments in the education system.
  • Understands the cross-curricular links to other content areas and is able to integrate learning across and between content areas (e.g. literacy, numeracy, critical thinking).
  • Knows, understands and critically evaluates the range of teaching and learning philosophies / theories and knows how to apply them appropriately within their subject (s).
  • Is aware of the range of supports available to support curriculum development and implementation.
  • Participates in and contributes to educational planning and development within the school e.g. lesson planning, subject department planning, etc.


Professional Practice

Understands the nature of high quality teaching and learning and demonstrates the skills and competencies to illustrate these.

Indicators include:

Planning and Preparation

  • Plans and communicates clear, challenging, appropriate and achievable expectations for students.
  • Shows knowledge and understanding of how to structure and schedule schemes of work, class plans, subject department plans etc.

Teaching and Learning

title: Process Simulation Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation's Process Technology (PT) business is a specialist division. We design and implement high-tech, process-centric projects across the Life Sciences, Chemical, Consumer Goods, Oil & Gas, and Energy sectors.

Reporting to the Process Team Lead, you will help integrate detailed process, mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation designs to deliver novel, end-to-end project solutions. You will develop both your core process engineering fundamentals and advanced process modelling capabilities. You will work with tools such as Aspen® simulation software, Mathcad®, Ansys®, and Autodesk® products, alongside AI-assisted engineering tools to enhance your skills and expertise.

  • Process Design, Simulation & Technical Delivery
    • Support execution of design studies across concept, basic, and detailed design phases
    • Maintain design deliverables including PFDs, P&IDs, equipment lists, and process descriptions
    • Perform process simulations and engineering calculations using tools such as Aspen® and Mathcad® to support:
    • Mass and energy balances
    • Equipment and line sizing
    • Pressure relief device sizing and hydraulic analysis
    • Use simulation outputs to validate designs, improve performance, and support engineering decisions
    • Support evaluation of Best Available Technologies (BAT) and process optimisation opportunities

Project Delivery and Coordination

  • Participate in project meetings and contribute to differant engineering teams
  • Coordinate with other disciplines i.e. (EC&I, Automation, Mechanical, and Validation) to provide integrated solutions
  • Support development of scope of work packages and engineering deliverables
  • Ensure resolution of process technical queries (TQs)

Safety, Compliance and Standards

  • Ensure all designs comply with client specifications, SOPs, and applicable standards (e.g., PED, ATEX, and GMP)
  • Support HAZOP preparation, participation, and close-out activities
  • Contribute to Hazardous Area Classification studies
  • Support process safety design, including pressure relief and safeguarding requirements

Commissioning & Site Support

  • Help develop and witness commissioning and startup protocols
  • Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for process equipment and packaged systems
  • Participate in site commissioning, startup, and troubleshooting activities
  • Provide on-site engineering support to construction and operations teams

Plan, Commercial & Quality

  • Help develop engineering cost estimates and inputs to sales proposals
  • Track engineering hours against project budgets, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, and cost targets
  • Identify and contribute to Design Change Requests (DCRs), including assessment of technical and commercial impacts
  • Ensure adherence to the Rockwell Automation Quality Management System (QMS)
  • Maintain process SOPs and engineering documentation
  • Ensure compliance with required training and applicable company procedures
  • Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant local, national, client, and international standards

The essentials - you will have:

  • Bachelor's degree or Better in Chemical / Process Engineering or a related discipline
  • Open to graduates or those looking to transitioning into a digital / simulation-focused design role with 1+ years experience
  • Demonstrate interested in - Process Design / Simulations / Sustainability / Functional Safety
  • A "can-do" approach, demonstrate ownership and quality work
  • Work with other engineering teams i.e. (EC&I, Automation, Mechanical, and Validation)
  • Willingness to travel internationally
  • Support on-site construction, commissioning, and startup activities
  • Full, clean driver's licence required

You might also have:

  • Exposure to project engineering or project delivery environments (desirable)
  • Experience or familiarity with process simulation tools (e.g. Aspen® suite) (desirable)
  • Familiarity with engineering calculation tools (e.g. Mathcad®) (desirable)
  • Exposure to 3D design / CAD software (e.g. AutoCAD® / Autodesk® products) (desirable)

What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

title: Experienced Power System Engineers
description:
About the job

At Premium Power we challenge and develop our engineers to meet their true capability.

We are currently looking for Experienced Power Systems Engineers who wish to expand their engineering knowledge and are keen to undertake new challenges.

About us

Premium Power is on a mission to provide best in class electrical engineering consulting on a global scale. We specialize in power systems, electrical safety and arc flash and we collaborate with an outstanding list of household names including Dell, Pfizer, GE and many more.

Our ambition is to be the leader in the provision of technology services for electrical energy systems and the optimization of power systems. We’ve made some great strides already and we’ve a lot more to do. Growing our team, we’re looking for a Power Systems Engineer to join us.

Premium Power is now an ABB company, forming part of ABB’s Electrification Service division. This marks an exciting new chapter for our team and significantly expands the opportunities available to our engineers. ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries run high-performance operations while improving energy efficiency and sustainability.

As part of ABB Electrification Service, Premium Power combines our deep expertise in power systems engineering with ABB’s global reach, advanced technologies, and innovation ecosystem. For our team and future graduates, this means access to world-class projects, cutting-edge tools, and the chance to contribute to the transformation of power systems at a global scale.

Purpose of the Role:

  • To work as a power engineer on a range of exciting projects for global clients in a rewarding team environment.
  • To develop technical and solution development skills to develop into an industry recognised consulting engineer.
  • The position would suit a practical and adaptable individual who wishes to work in a progressive innovative electrical consultancy.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical input and leadership on a variety of complex projects.
  • Work closely with and interpret client requirements and translate into deliverables.
  • Ensure project outputs meet client satisfaction, time and budgetary requirements.
  • Conduct in-depth power systems analysis.
  • Prepare detailed technical and non-technical reports.
  • Attend client meetings remotely, manage expectations through effective communications and timely responsiveness.
  • Track and report on project performance and client satisfaction.
  • Mentor, coach and develop more junior engineers. On-line training to be delivered where applicable.
  • Become familiar with the company’s quality system and try to enhance where possible.
  • Have an active role in internal workshops and groups that benefit the company’s growth.
  • Be actively involved in the company’s sales strategies, with previous experience and ideas welcome for enhancing the companies international portfolio.

Typical projects include:

  • Strategic power system analysis: redundancy, short circuit, power flow, protection coordination
  • Electrical safety analysis: arc flash and electrical risk assessments.
  • Grid connection and embedded generation connections analysis: static & dynamic transient stability, harmonics, flicker, transformer inrush.
  • Power quality evaluation: earthing, harmonics, sag ride-through.
  • Electrical systems reliability assessments.
  • Software based analysis solutions.
  • Supporting wind project and installation teams.
  • Emerging technology reviews.
  • Failure investigations and advice.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • Qualified Electrical Engineer with 3+ years of previous power systems study experience including short circuit, protection coordination and arc flash.
  • Demonstrated experience with Power System Study software (SKM, EasyPower, ETAP, or similar).
  • Experience in designing unit protection settings e.g. Bus and transformer differential 87B & 87T, Restricted Earth Fault, and Directional Protection 67.
  • Ability to carry out cable sizing calculations according to the relevant standards such as IEC 60502-2 and IEC60364-5-52.
  • Experience with Power quality and harmonic analysis would be favourable.
  • Expert on design, calculations, and specifications associated with power system protection.
  • Proven application of protection coordination studies.
  • Superior relationship building and stakeholder management.
  • High performance with a love of learning.
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication, written and verbal.

What we can offer

  • Excellent career development, award winning projects and an excellent remuneration package.
  • High commitment by management to training and career development
  • Premium Power employees work on interesting projects in a supportive and friendly environment, whilst earning market leading salaries.
  • Premium Power offers the opportunity to work within an exciting and growing sector on a diverse range of technical, strategic and regulatory consultancy projects for various industries: Data Centres, Pharma, Medical, Semi Conductor, Food & Beverage, Heavy Industry, etc.
  • Discretionary annual performance-based bonus
  • Flexible working hours

  • Paid membership fees for one professional institute
  • Excellent CPD programme

Vacancy ID: VN3976

Business Unit:

Job Location: Dublin

Description

TLI Group are accepting applications for Graduate Engineers (Level 8 qualified). The successful applicants will also take part in our Graduate Pathway Programme.

TLI Group offer a full turnkey service utilising the latest in design software tools to provide a thorough technical design and build solution that assures the lowest optimum cost, whilst ensuring we meet challenges, manage the risk and strive to meet our client’s requirements.

We design, build and maintain vital services, connecting people on behalf of our customers.

Package:
Competitive rates of pay.
23 Days annual leave.
Sick pay after completion of probation.
Take part in our “Career Pathway Programme”, where there is an emphasis on training & career development.
Opportunity to progress your career within a growing company.
Supports to achieve chartered status.
Voluntary Pension available on completion of probation.
Employee membership for our LAYA EAP Programme – 24/7 Mental Wellbeing Support & Employee Assistance Programme.
Health Insurance Discount.
Life Assurance Payment
Standard industry training provided.

Key Responsibilities

  • Working under the direction of the Operations Team;
  • Liaising with crew supervisors to get updates from site and upload to Sharepoints;
  • Updating revenue trackers with metrics from site;
  • Setting up of New Project Codes with Procurement to track Project Costs
  • Updating ArcGIS system with info from our owns crews and sub-contractors;
  • Updating ArcGIS system with future developments ahead of time;
  • Working closely with the GIS team to develop the system further and fix any bugs that the site crews are experiencing
  • Preparation of material specifications & BOQ;
  • Preparation of calculations and drawings;
  • Processing of survey information;
  • Temporary works design.
  • Occasional travel to and from work sites

Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum Degree qualified – Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (NFQ Level 8)
  • Relevant industry experience though not essential, would be an advantage
  • Strong technical and design ability essential
  • Strong IT skills required. Knowledge of AutoCad, ArcGIS, Word, Excel, Microsoft Projects would be an advantage, but training will be provided where necessary
  • Excellent team worker with effective communication and interpersonal skills
  • Full drivers licence will be necessary
  • Formal report writing and professional presentation of work essential

title: Graduate Design Engineer
description:
As a Graduate Design Engineer, you will join our design team and play an active role in developing new and existing products. You will gain hands-on experience working from concept through to manufacture, collaborating closely with the workshop team to bring designs to life.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated graduate to develop their skills in a practical, real-world engineering environment.

​

What we Offer:

We pride ourselves on providing a supportive environment for graduates to grow and develop. You will gain experience across all aspects of design and manufacturing, working on a wide range of projects.

You will be given real responsibility from an early stage, with the opportunity to contribute ideas and see your work progress through to completion.

​

Requirements:

Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Agricultural Engineering or related discipline

Strong interest in design and engineering

Good communication skills

Ability to work as part of a team

Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail

Experience with CAD software is desirable

Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings is an advantage

Previous engineering or work placement experience is a bonus but not essential

Pay: €35,000.00-€55,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Design Engineer
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen within Jungheinrich Ireland for you to join our logistics team as a Design Engineer.

The Role

Operating out of Maynooth, the successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the design, development, and implementation of automated warehouse systems and material handling solutions, working closely with senior engineers, project managers, sales teams, and installation teams to deliver efficient and innovative solutions for customers across Ireland.

Reporting to the Systems Manager, specific responsibilities include:

Design & Engineering

  • Assist in the design of automation and warehouse equipment layouts using CAD software (e.g. AutoCAD).
  • Prepare technical drawings, GA layouts, fabrication drawings, and assembly details.
  • Support the design of conveyor systems, racking interfaces, guarding, mezzanines, and warehouse flow solutions.
  • Produce engineering calculations, load assessments, and design validations.
  • Modify existing designs based on customer requirements or site conditions.

Project Support

  • Assist with project delivery from concept through installation and commissioning.
  • Attend customer sites for surveys, measurements, and technical assessments.
  • Support procurement by preparing BOMs (Bills of Materials) and component specifications.
  • Liaise with suppliers and subcontractors regarding technical queries.
  • Support installation teams with technical documentation and issue resolution.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure designs comply with Irish and EU safety standards, machinery directives, CE requirements, and internal engineering standards.
  • Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate engineering records and document control procedures.

The Person

You will work in collaboration with senior engineers, project managers, sales teams and installation teams to deliver efficient and innovative solutions for customers across Ireland.

Candidates must have:

  • 1 to 3 years' engineering experience (or a strong graduate candidate with placement experience).
  • Experience using CAD software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
  • Strong technical drawing and design interpretation skills.
  • Degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a similar discipline.
  • Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel within Ireland.
  • Fully computer literate with Microsoft packages, including Word, Excel, Outlook, SAP, etc.

Desirable

  • Experience in conveyor systems, warehouse equipment, racking, or industrial automation.
  • Familiarity with PLC systems, sensors, motors, or controls.
  • Knowledge of CE marking / machinery safety regulations.
  • Project engineering or installation support experience.

This role is ideal for an ambitious engineer looking to develop their career in industrial automation, mechanical design, and warehouse systems integration.

In return we offer:

We invest in talent and have a culture of openness, integrity and respect. Our remuneration package is highly competitive and includes:

  • Excellent basic salary
  • Hybrid working arrangement
  • Company health insurance plan
  • Generous occupational sick pay scheme
  • Company pension contribution
  • Long service recognition
  • Company mobile phone and laptop provided
  • Life assurance with death in service benefit
  • Generous annual leave incorporating long service
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Plus, many more

Apply now to join a team of people at Jungheinrich who will assist you to achieve your career objectives and who are passionate to succeed.

title: Project Design Engineer (Mechanical) REF: 2605b
description:
Fingleton White provide multidiscipline engineering services for the energy industry. We provide a full range of design, construction and commissioning services and are active across many sectors including Renewables, Gas Networks, Water, Energy & Utilities, and Asset Management. The company is responsible for planning and development of some of the most significant projects in the energy sector in Ireland. We have 8 offices across England, Northern Ireland and Ireland with over 200 staff.


Who We Are….

We have a proven track record of delivering lasting solutions which we design based on a first principles approach. Our priority is to get the engineering fundamentals right.


Fingleton White is a company that has been built on sustainability. Our very first project was a hydroelectric power station. Over our 40-year history, we have developed our own projects which have delivered CO emissions savings of well over 2 million tonnes. We are focussed on reducing our carbon footprint and having a positive impact on our environment and communities through our biodiversity initiatives, our energy efficiency programmes and implementing sustainable development targets.


Our Projects….

We deliver projects across the diverse range of the water, wastewater, and biosolids spectrum. This ranges from traditional detailed designs in the municipal water industry, to cutting edge efficiency, carbon capture, and resource recovery schemes for industrial clients. We operate across the full range of feasibility studies, outline design, detailed design, as well as support during construction and commissioning.


Our People….

Our people are our only asset and are our USP. Our people are key to everything we do.


Business and client requirements are constantly changing; it is essential that we provide the tools to allow our team to develop their skills and expertise to match these demands. We challenge our engineers to develop and progress within the organisation. Our Development and Progression Framework details how people can develop within their roles and progress their career within the organisation.


Fingleton White is an Engineers Ireland's CPD Accredited Employer and we have systems in place to provide employees with targeted training and experience relevant to their grade. Chartership is supported and encouraged through CPD and mentoring and is a requirement for senior engineering roles in the organisation.


We will provide you with all the training you need, exposure to projects, responsibility and real engineering experience to maximise your talents as an engineer.



Position:

The Role….

Project Design Engineer – REF: 2605b


We are looking to recruit a Mechanical Project Design Engineer to join our Water design team. The successful candidate will join a growing team with senior support and will have the opportunity as their career progresses to acquire a broad range of skills and experience in design and project management.


The role will provide you with essential engineering, communications and project delivery skills which are transferrable across any engineering project.


The following are examples of the types of project work that the Project Design Engineer will have the opportunity to work on:

  • Lead and deliver mechanical design across a range of water sector projects typically including municipal water and wastewater pumping stations and treatment plants
  • Work within a design team including Mechanical, Process, Civil, E&I, CP and drafting team members
  • Collaborate and plan design work and deliverables together with wider process MEICA team
  • Design from conceptual phase through to project completion
  • Development of Preliminary and Detailed Design reports, calculations and drawings
  • Mentoring mechanical engineers promoting knowledge-sharing and team development in design in the water infrastructure
  • Development and technical assurance of design including use of relevant software packages such as SUMO, WAVE, AFT or equivalent
  • Producing design drawings, mechanical plant selection, technical specifications and P&ID’s
  • Preparing and checking design of mechanical installations
  • Producing hydraulic calculations for gravity and pumped systems including pumping system analysis / pump selection
  • Manage project budgets, schedules, and deliverables to meet agreed targets
  • Ensuring all designs are completed in accordance with the relevant standards and specifications
  • Ensuring all designs comply with all applicable Health and Safety standards and regulations
  • Attending progress meetings with our Water design team, clients, contractors & suppliers


As the engineer’s career progresses, they will be afforded opportunity to experience all aspects of project delivery and other areas of the business.


The location for this role will be in Kilkenny.


Requirements:

The Candidate….

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Engineering degree (Honours bachelor’s degree or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, or similar discipline relevant to the specification above
  • 5+ years post-graduate experience
  • Experience in the Water industry
  • Excellent computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Familiar with AutoCAD 'Plant 3D' modelling
  • Knowledge of hydraulics design packages (Infoworks or Hades) would be beneficial
  • Good academic record
  • Full clean driving license and own transport requi

title: Associate Systems Administrator
description:
Who we are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years.

What we do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role overview

The Associate Systems Administrator is an entry-level position within the IT Systems team based in our Dublin office. This role serves as a critical bridge between our IT Service Desk and Global Systems functions, primarily focusing on supporting our EU and UK-based employees.

You will work closely with the IT Service Desk team to resolve technical escalations while aligning with US-based systems engineers to maintain global applications, security policies, patching standards, and network infrastructure across our European locations. This role requires a blend of operational support, technical curiosity, and a commitment to maintaining a secure, highly available environment. On Call work may be required with this roll as needed by the business.

In addition to the responsibilities above, this role also requires regular physical activity, including moving around the office to assist with IT or AV event related tasks, lifting and carrying equipment (upwards of 50lbs), moving tables and chairs, and plugging in devices under desks and other confined spaces. The Associate Systems Administrator must be able to perform these duties safely and efficiently as part of their responsibilities.

What you'll do

System Administration & Support

  • Perform daily monitoring, management, and troubleshooting for core corporate enterprise software platforms.
  • Assist with the configuration, deployment, and maintenance of identity platforms and collaboration tools.
  • Follow established change management procedures for system updates and modifications.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation, including runbooks and knowledge base articles for the Service Desk.

Workspace & Endpoint Management

  • Support the administration of Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune.
  • Assist in managing end-user devices, including software deployments, VDI deployment and desktop configurations.
  • Help implement and enforce security measures like software patches and OS updates.

Networking & Infrastructure

  • Provide first-level support for network escalations, including Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewall issues.
  • Assist with basic network troubleshooting and performance monitoring for EU office environments.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of local network hardware under senior guidance.

Identity & Security Compliance

  • Manage user lifecycles within identity platforms (e.g., Okta) to ensure appropriate access controls.
  • Contribute to incident response efforts by participating in a regional on-call rotation.
  • Review incoming IT requests to ensure alignment with company Information Security and governance policies.

What you'll bring

Required Skills & Experience

  • Foundational experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms such as Okta or OneLogin.
  • Proficiency working within enterprise ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian/Jira).
  • Experience with enterprise collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, and Slack.
  • Exposure to MDM tools such as Microsoft Intune or Jamf.
  • Basic understanding of enterprise networking principles and troubleshooting techniques.Demonstrated ability to document technical processes and follow standard operating procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Audiovisual (AV) setup and troubleshooting for conference rooms.
  • Basic administration experience with enterprise cloud-based telephony systems (e.g., Dialpad).
  • A background in Systems Administration (min 2 years experience) and some experience with IT support or service desk operations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones.


Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their p

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
DESCRIPTION

Come help us create innovative capabilities for Amazon's Associates, managers, and leaders to support the evolution of People eXperience and Technology (PXT). The Workforce Solutions (WS) team builds and delivers world-class products/services for Amazon's employees, we believe that happy Amazon customers start with happy Amazon employees! We give Amazon associates around the globe the flexibility to enrich their job experience through pay incentives and job mobility. We thrive on developing world-class experiences for associates worldwide to empower them to increase their income, explore job options, train, choose, and progress in their careers at Amazon. As a member of this team, you are changing people's lives by creating the tools that help them advance in their careers! We're seeking a self-driven professional with strong communication skills who can deliver high-quality results in our fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
  • Development of the end-to-end services and processes to give Amazon employees options for pay, training, and job choices
  • Build the most extensive pay premium, job training, and career mobility options on earth
  • Use modern technologies to solve complex problems at scale
  • Deliver solutions that scale in volume and handle the complexity of diverse workflows and country specific rules/regulations.
  • Own automation of business processes in a full stack, mostly server-less environment using proven, as well as evolving native AWS services and other technologies to create a friction free user experience.
  • Solve the challenging problem of scaling these services to serve hundreds of thousands of Amazonians across the globe in real-time
  • Be a technical innovator that is not afraid to challenge the norms and innovate.
  • Execute against project plans and delivery commitments.
  • Build highly available, scalable, and performant tier-one services to power responsive, intuitive, and sleek experiences for customers.
  • Solve complex business and technical problems by diving deep, collecting data to make well informed decisions, and using sound judgement in the face of insufficient data.
  • Work with the latest technologies to innovate on behalf of the employee.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, develop, and test Amazon-scale enterprise business systems serving hundreds of thousands associates worldwide. You will also continuously learn new technologies, the latest industry techniques, and gets to use the newest AWS tools. In addition, you will get to develop new systems, support robust business tools, and integrate with other internal systems within Amazon's world-class operations.

About the team
Workforce Solutions (WS) is a horizontal, multi-discipline organization whose mission is to build the best people-forward technology to enable corporate recruitment for Amazon, globally. We build the intelligent technology products Amazon uses to make the right hiring decisions, every time, while being more equitable and candidate-centric in the end-to-end experience. We accomplish this by using our ability in product and program management, and design/research. Our portfolio of products is global (built mostly on native AWS), accounting for recruitment for all corporate roles. From the candidate-facing job site, to ensuring the role is filled - we build the entire gamut. We value people-centric solutions, and open exchange of ideas. The team has a clear product and service north star, but remains flexible in the paths to achieve that goal.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
  • Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Japanese Speaking Technical Support Engineer
description:
Japanese-Speaking Technical Support Engineer

At Dell Technologies, world-class service doesn’t end when a customer purchases our innovative products. Our Technical Support team is there for them whenever they need help – by phone or email, online and on social media. No matter how complex the challenge, we rise to it. We answer questions about the installation, operation, configuration, customization and use of Dell Technologies products. For critical matters, we use our systems to provide remote diagnostic technical support. If there’s an issue with a customer’s product, we’ll analyze it, identify the cause, recommend a solution and document the problem.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Japanese-speaking Technical Support Engineer on our Technical Support Team in Cork or Dublin.


What you’ll achieve
As a Technical Support Engineer, you will resolve complex technical issues in a fast-paced, customer critical environment, working on improving processes, standards and strategies to perfect our Support Services.

You will:

  • Act as a customer advocate, communicating clear action plans and driving timely escalations.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with field, engineering, and local Japan teams, including during critical events.
  • Manage case priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure consistent, closed‑loop communication.
  • Contribute to knowledge creation, and support continuous improvement of support processes.


Take the first step towards your dream career
Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements

  • Native‑level Japanese proficiency (spoken and written), plus strong English communication skills (spoken and written)
  • Ability to perform technical troubleshooting to identify issues and support resolution using diagnostic tools and technical knowledge
  • Ability to work under pressure with a strong customer focus and service mindset. Effective interpersonal and presentation skills for customer‑facing communication
  • Solid escalation judgment and ability to collaborate across teams to resolve issues. Solid previous experience in a customer service or customer‑facing support role
  • 2+ years of Japanese customer support experience as an IT Infrastructure Support Engineer


Desirable Requirements

  • Relevant technical certifications such as ISM v5, PowerStore/Unity Associate
  • PowerEdge Associate (LPIC‑1 or VCP‑DCV preferred)



Who we are

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

Application closing date: Apply today!

Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Title: Network Engineer

Company: Critical IT Infrastructure Managed Services Business

Location: Dublin, Ireland

Position Type: Full-time, Hybrid Working

We are working with a leading technology solutions provider based in Ireland, specializing in network infrastructure and IT services. We partner with organizations of all sizes to deliver innovative and reliable solutions that optimize their network performance, security, and scalability. As a Network Engineer you will be an integral part of our team, working on challenging projects and collaborating with talented professionals in a dynamic and supportive environment.

Job Summary:We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of our clients' network infrastructure. As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, security, and performance of our clients' networks, as well as troubleshooting any issues that arise. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and clients to understand their requirements, design scalable network solutions, and provide ongoing support.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure solutions for clients based on their specific requirements.
  • Configure and troubleshoot network equipment, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Perform network monitoring and analysis to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Identify and resolve network-related issues, such as connectivity, latency, and security vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate network solutions with other IT systems and applications.
  • Develop and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and procedures.
  • Conduct network capacity planning and make recommendations for network expansion and upgrades.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in network engineering.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior network engineers as needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Proven experience as a Network Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of network protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF).
  • Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network equipment from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, or Palo Alto Networks.
  • Experience with network security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and techniques.
  • Ability to analyze and solve complex network issues efficiently.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities, with the capacity to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent.
  • Experience with software-defined networking (SDN) technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud networking principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Familiarity with network virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware NSX, Cisco ACI).
  • Experience with network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible).

How to Apply:If you are a motivated Network Engineer with legal permission to work in Ireland and seeking an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact in a collaborative environment, please submit your resume (CV) to the link provided for instant consideration.

At Arthur Cox, our success depends on attracting the best people and nurturing their talent so we can provide our clients with services to the highest standards. In recent years, there has been a shift in the demands of our clients who require legal services outside of the work of traditional legal practice. With this in mind, we have launched our Corporate Graduate Programme for graduates who wish to work in a legal environment, but who are not seeking to pursue a career as a lawyer.

About the Programme:
The Corporate Graduate Programme is designed to help graduates decide which area of legal services is the right fit for them. The programme is for graduates of law, or those who have had exposure to law or corporate governance within their degree.

The two-year programme comprises four six-month rotations and participation in the internal training programme. Each rotation offers exposure to high-calibre clients and work, with comprehensive support and training provided to equip you with the key skills required to succeed in each area. You will gain experience across a range of departments, with ongoing support from partners, practice group members, the programme coordinator, and the HR team throughout your journey. Following successful completion of the programme and upon securing a permanent role, individuals may be eligible for a bursary to support further education.

  • Listings Executives advise our client base on legal and practical requirements with regard to listing securities and investment funds on relevant stock exchanges and producing documentation to facilitate client goals. The listings executives work in the Listings Practice Group which is part of our Finance Department.

  • Data Management and Analytics Professionals work in varying roles which can include managing GDPR related concerns and mapping, storing, and analysing key data relating to our essential business functions. Roles in this area have previously arisen in our Business Development Team and our IT Teams.

description:

Junior Credit Analyst, Investec Europe Limited

Investec – Where Out of the Ordinary Happens

At Investec, we do things differently. We're a leading international bank and wealth manager built on a culture of curiosity, entrepreneurial spirit and human connection. Ideas are heard, ambition is celebrated, and impact is encouraged. About the team:

The IEL Risk Team sits within Investec Europe Limited and works at the heart of how we manage credit risk across our Treasury Products & Distribution (TPD) business. You'll work closely with the Head of Credit Risk, our TPD Sales Team, and Group Credit & Risk Management colleagues — acting as the key bridge between the Front Office and Credit on FX, derivatives and broader treasury activity. It's a highly interactive role with real exposure to Credit Committee, senior management and a broad cross-section of the business.


What will I be doing?

  • Prepare new credit applications for the TPD Sales Team — recommending trading limits, assessing the creditstrengthand trading requirements of newly-signed clients, using approved internal rating models and credit assessment methodologies, and presenting at Desk Credit Committee or Senior Credit Committee for approval.
  • Manage annual credit reviews for existing corporate clients — providing limit-change recommendations to Front Office based on a view of clients' financial and non-financial metrics, historical FX and other derivative activity, and discussing key risks with Credit Committee.

  • Prepare month-end and quarterly credit activity and credit exposure reports.
  • Hold a weekly discussion with the Head of TPD to walk through upcoming credit reviews, limitchangesand margin issues.
  • Work closely with Legal to ensure Facility Letters are received back — circulating Legal's weekly list to the Dealers and Sales Team and following up with clients directly.
  • Take on ad hoc work for the Treasury Credit Team, including industry analysis, customer reports, screening of new clients, customer biographies for internal events, sales pipeline and sector analysis, limit utilisation and net exposure reports, regulatory working groups, and presentations for the new business team.
  • Act as the day-to-day liaison between the TPD and Credit Teams — bringing a proactive, collaborative approach to keep both sides aligned.
  • Take on project work end-to-end: research, design, implement and deliver projects asrequired.
  • Provide Credit Committee with well-researched, clearly presented business,creditand financial analysis on existing and proposed deals.
  • Prepare deal summaries and transaction updates for credit reporting.
  • Act as a key point of contact for Credit Reporting — ensuring the accuracy of reporting dashboards and that they align with Risk Appetite and Senior Management requirements.
  • Partner with the Credit Reporting team to shape forward-looking dashboard and portfolio reporting requirements.
  • Work with Credit Risk Business Analysts to develop and formatmethodologyrequirements for trading book analysis, monitoring and reporting.

What do I need to bring?

  • A third-level qualification in Business, Maths,Scienceor a similar discipline.
  • Work experience in a credit, risk or financial services role is desirable.
  • Strong financial analysis skills — the ability to interpret financial statements and form a balanced credit judgment.
  • A good understanding of FX, Interest Rate and Commodity Futures, Options,Swapsand other derivatives.
  • Familiarity with derivative exposure methodologies — current and statistically expected future exposures, Credit Threshold and Collateral Margining concepts.
  • Knowledge of Financial Institutions across a range of geographies, as well as Credit Rating Agency methodologies.
  • Awareness of legal documentation and key credit terms relevant to ISDA / CSA / GMRA / GMSLA.
  • An understanding of IT systems andprocesses, andworking knowledge of Bloomberg or other financial research and portfolio management tools.
  • Regulatory knowledge relevant to the role, and the integrity to act in line with the philosophy oftreating customers fairly at all times.

I am good at:

  • Strong numerical reasoning and accuracy, with sharp attention to detail.
  • Interpreting complex credit applications and producing executive summaries that clearly highlight strengths and weaknesses.
  • Analysing a counterparty's business model, the competitive environment itoperatesin, and the risks to that model.
  • Making balanced credit judgments and weighing commerciality against risk versus reward.

title: AI Risk Analyst - 1LOD
description:
What is the opportunity?

The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is the Bank's powerhouse for safe, responsible and scalable AI adoption. It sets the vision, standards and governance that shape how AI is built and deployed across the organisation, while providing the platforms, expertise and partnership needed to turn ideas into high value outcomes.

This role establishes a critical new capability focused on AI trustworthiness and performance. It defines how AI model outputs are tested, monitored and governed across the Bank, from accuracy and bias to hallucination and explainability.

The opportunity is to shape responsible AI standards in practice, influence regulatory alignment, and build a scalable evaluation framework that underpins confidence in AI driven decision making across the organisation.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and operationalize the AI model evaluation framework across all archetypes, covering accuracy, bias, hallucination, explainability, robustness, ethical compliance and guardrail thresholds.
  • Lead end to end evaluation processes from pathfinder through production, developing quantitative and qualitative testing methodologies for generative AI, classical ML and decisioning models.
  • Handle LLMOps monitoring, including performance dashboards, drift detection, degradation alerts and retraining triggers, ensuring outputs feed into 1LOD and 2LOD risk assessments, regulatory submissions and model risk documentation.
  • Produce governance ready evaluation reporting, contribute to the AI risk taxonomy and maintain alignment with evolving regulatory expectations and industry standards.
  • Build organisational capability through guidance, tooling and knowledge sharing, while applying evaluation frameworks to third party AI systems and vendor models.

What will make you stand out?

  • Deep expertise in AI/ML model evaluation and monitoring including generative AI, LLMs and MLOps/LLMOps practices such as drift detection and lifecycle management.
  • Strong grounding in responsible AI principles (bias, explainability, fairness, ethics) and experience developing quantitative and qualitative evaluation frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of financial services AI regulation (EBA model risk guidelines, EU AI Act) with the ability to translate complex model behaviour into clear, actionable insights for non-technical partners.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering across risk, delivery and technology teams; financial services experience highly desirable.
  • Commitment to responsible innovation, ethical standards and continuous professional development.

Essential Qualifications

There are no specific qualifications or minimum educational requirements needed for this role.

More about the team

Working at the intersection of innovation and control, the CoE ensures the Bank can unlock meaningful business impact from AI while upholding the highest expectations of ethics, risk management and regulatory compliance. It's where pioneering capability meets focused execution enabling the Bank to harness AI with confidence, clarity and ambition.
