title: Junior Systems Administrator
description:
Junior Systems Administrator

Location: Dundalk


About Us

GenetiQ delivers perfect-fit software solutions that elevate the businesses of our customers. Powered by our customer-focused, collaborative and innovative team, our software is used by more than 2,500 businesses worldwide.

Continuously innovating since 1992, our open and trusting environment has created lasting relationships. GenetiQ's founders and many of our first team members are still a core part of the organisation. Our employees drive our culture and success and our goal is to inspire, support and help them to develop – and enjoy – their careers.

GenetiQ was honoured in the Deloitte Fast 50 for the fourth year running in 2020. To stay future-focused, we are always looking for dynamic team players who are customer-focused and share our enthusiasm for technology. If this sounds like you, then come elevate your career at GenetiQ.


Scope of Role

The rewarding career you are looking for is at GenetiQ Software. If you enjoy working with technology and thrive in a hands-on, fast-paced environment, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build foundational IT skills while supporting core business systems.


As a Junior Systems Administrator within the Internal Systems Team, you will support the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and security of GenetiQ’s IT environment. You will gain exposure to a wide range of technologies including Microsoft 365, Windows devices, user access management, and core infrastructure.


Working under the guidance of senior Internal Systems staff, you will contribute to the delivery of reliable and secure IT services across the organisation, while developing the technical and professional capabilities required to progress within the Internal Systems function.


Responsibilities

The Junior Systems Administrator will support the Internal Systems Team in delivering high-quality IT services across the business. Your responsibilities will include assisting with user support, system administration tasks, and maintaining operational stability across core systems.


Key areas of responsibility include:


  • Supporting user onboarding, offboarding, and access changes (joiners, movers, leavers)
  • Managing user accounts, permissions, and groups within Active Directory / Entra ID
  • Assisting with Microsoft 365 administration including mailboxes, licences, and access controls
  • Providing end-user support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals
  • Supporting device setup, provisioning, and configuration (e.g. Intune / Autopilot)
  • Troubleshooting basic hardware, software, and connectivity issues, escalating where required
  • Assisting with the maintenance of Windows servers, cloud services, and business systems
  • Performing routine system checks, updates, and maintenance activities
  • Supporting backup, monitoring, and basic security processes under supervision
  • Following IT security policies and reporting potential risks or incidents
  • Maintaining accurate IT documentation, asset registers, and user guides
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of IT processes and standards

Skills and Abilities

A person that has some of the following skills and abilities would be at a distinct advantage:


  • A logical and structured approach to problem-solving with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and identify appropriate solutions
  • Willingness to learn and develop new technical skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and user-friendly way
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
  • A professional, reliable, and customer-focused approach

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

A person applying for this role must have:


  • A qualification in IT, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • Some experience in an IT support, helpdesk, or technical environment (including placements or internships)
  • Experience in any of the following is desirable but not essential, as training will be provided:
  • Active Directory and/or Entra ID
  • Microsoft 365 administration (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
  • Device management tools such as Intune
  • Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing)
  • Windows 10/11 environments and basic Windows Server exposure
  • IT ticketing or ITSM systems
  • Awareness of IT security best practices

Relevant certifications (or working towards) are advantageous, for example:


  • Microsoft Fundamentals (MS-900, AZ-900)
  • CompTIA A+ or Network+

Benefits and Culture

Our perfect fit ethos extends to our employees, ensuring that our roles, environment, benefits and progression paths are geared toward their professional and personal development.


As noted, our employees drive our culture. Our iSocial group organises a number of GenetiQ social events and activities throughout the year, such as summer BBQs, golf outings, charity hikes and more.

title: Graduate Stakeholder Engagement Consultant
description:
Overview

AtkinsRealis is one of the world's leading providers of engineering professional consulting and support services, with offices across Ireland. We are currently seeking a Graduate Stakeholder Engagement Consultant to join our Stakeholder Engagement Team to support the delivery of complex infrastructure projects from inception through to construction.

As a Graduate Stakeholder Engagement Consultant you will be responsible for identifying and engaging with relevant project stakeholders including, landowners, members of the public, community groups, businesses, and elected representatives. You will support the delivery of all project communications including, preparation of key project messages, website and social media content, as well as letters, brochures, leaflets, and display material for public information events. Your mission will be to develop and maintain positive relationships with all project stakeholders to: build trust, ensure transparent communication, and support inclusive engagement throughout each phase of the project.

This exciting role will provide you with the opportunity to work within multi-disciplinary teams on major infrastructure projects across a broad range of sectors including; Energy, Rail, Active Travel, Highways, and Water. We are looking for confident individuals with excellent communication skills who can articulate complex information to a wide range of stakeholders in a manner which is clear and easy to understand. Knowledge of the various statutory planning processes in Ireland e.g. Compulsory Purchase Orders, Railway Orders, Part 8 etc. will also be advantageous.

Your role

  • Assist in developing and delivering clear, engaging project communication plans that build awareness, strengthen understanding, and encourage proactive participation from all stakeholders.
  • Identify and engage with a range of project stakeholders including landowners, members of the public, community groups, businesses, and elected representatives, to provide project updates and address any queries or issues.
  • Support the development and delivery of project communications, including letters, brochures, leaflets, display material, digital content, newsletters, and press releases.
  • Coordinate public information events to share project updates with members of the public and other key stakeholders.
  • Respond to project queries from stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of engagement activities and feedback received.
  • Undertake desktop research of land and property affected by infrastructure projects.
  • Work closely with technical teams to ensure stakeholder needs are fully understood, accurately reflected in project decisions, and communicated clearly throughout the engagement process.

About you

  • Degree educated in a land or planning related discipline e.g. Geography, Planning, Environmental Management, or Estate / Property Management.
  • Excellent communication skills, particularly in face-to-face meetings, as well as written content such as letters, emails, and communication material.
  • Experience working on infrastructure projects will be advantageous.
  • Flexibility in approach to managing workload, with the ability to multi-task and prioritise when necessary.
  • Strong attention to detail particularly in preparing communication materials.
  • A confident individual with a positive outlook and an approachable friendly manner.
  • The ability to work effectively within a large team, or to work alone as required.
  • A highly motivated individual who will contribute to the growth of the Stakeholder Engagement Team.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries and a brilliant range of health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle benefits. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture, international remote working opportunities, and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

  • Experience with office-style applications e.g ability to create macros, spreadsheet formulae, etc.

  • Wants to be part of a team that is committed to delivering high quality innovative products.
  • Wants to be part of a culture that is committed to sharing and enhancing the knowledge of the wider team, supporting team wide learning and success

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

title: Technical Stream
description:
The following positions are open:

Internship (3 months)

Outcomex is a multiple award-winning Australian systems integrator and Cisco Partner, delivering end-to-end IT solutions and managed services since 2006. Our expertise spans enterprise networking, data centre, cyber security, collaboration, IoT, hybrid cloud, and managed services, partnering with vendors including Cisco, Microsoft, and more. We’re an engineering-led organisation that prides itself on speed, agility, and proven performance.


About the Program

We’re opening our doors to two streams of interns for a 3-month program designed to give you real exposure to how a modern systems integrator runs — from the engineering bench right through to sales operations and partner relationships.

We’re hiring across two pathways:

Technical Stream — for students or recent graduates with an IT, computer science, engineering, networking, or cyber security background.

Business Stream — for students or recent graduates with a business, commerce, marketing, or related background looking for hands-on experience in tech sales and operations.


What You’ll Do

Across both streams, you can expect to:

  • Shadow our technical team in customer and vendor meetings, gaining a front-row view of how solutions are scoped, designed, and pitched
  • Participate in technology evaluations — sit in on proof-of-concepts, demos, and assessments of new vendor offerings
  • Assist with and participate in vendor and customer events, both internal and external — from intimate briefings to larger industry gatherings
  • Contribute to sales and partner operations, including auditing partner programs and certifications work that keeps the engine running smoothly

You’ll be working alongside senior engineers, account managers, and operations specialists — and we’ll make sure your three months give you something genuinely worth putting on a CV.


Who We’re Looking For

  • Currently studying or recently graduated in a relevant discipline (IT/engineering/computer science for the Technical Stream; business/commerce/marketing for the Business Stream)
  • Curious, proactive, and keen to learn how the tech industry actually works
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Detail-oriented — especially for the audit and documentation work
  • Comfortable in client-facing environments (or keen to get comfortable)
  • Australian working rights

Locations

  • Sydney — North Ryde
  • Melbourne – South Melbourne

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short cover note telling us which stream you’re applying for and what you’re hoping to get out of the three months to recruitment@outcomex.com.au.

Outcomex is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.


Technical Stream — for students or recent graduates with an IT, computer science, engineering, networking, or cyber security background.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Job: site Reliability Engineer

Location: North Dublin

Rate: 450-500 per day

Type: Contract (12 months+)

Working arrangement: Hybrid (1-2 days onsite per week)

We have an excellent role for a combined Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Observability Engineering role to oversee and ensuring that complex software systems are reliable, scalable, making sure the systems transparent is measurable through advanced monitoring and data analysis. The role is based with a leading business within the aviation sector.

Some of the Responsibilities will include:

  • Work within the technology team to implement the SRE strategy and roadmap of best practices.
  • Monitor capacity availability and system health of production environments.
  • Improve reliability, quality, and time-to-market for all applications
  • Build systems and introduce tooling to manage applications and infrastructure
  • Design, implement, and maintain the observability platform (metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting) to support developers and operators.
  • Own and evolve tooling and infrastructure related to Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry or similar observability tools.
  • Collaborate with SREs, developers, and infrastructure teams to define SLOs, SLAs, and SLIs and ensure proper instrumentation of services.
  • Improve system performance and reliability through monitoring insights and proactive detection of anomalies.
  • Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual effort and improve response times for incidents.
  • Enable development teams with self-service dashboards and alerting configurations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response processes to identify and address observability gaps.
  • Offer primary operational support for distributed software applications
  • Work with development team and build process to ensure tools and automation is in place to ensure reliable and quality code deployments.
  • Work with development teams to test and improve services

The Red Team Engineer will conduct comprehensive, intelligence‑driven assessments of enterprise applications, critical infrastructure components, and associated operational and technical security controls. title: Application Security Engineer
description:

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments.   • Static analysis (SAST)
  • Dynamic testing (DAST)
  • Penetration testing
  • Identify, triage, and validate vulnerabilities
  • Support remediation and verify fixes

3. DevSecOps, Automation & AI Enablement

  • Integrate security tools into CI/CD pipelines
  • Automate scanning, reporting, and ticketing workflows
  • Build tooling to scale AppSec across products
  • Leverage AI/ML capabilities to enhance vulnerability detection, prioritization, and remediation workflows

4. Risk Assessment & Vulnerability Management

  • Assess risk, exploitability, and impact
  • Prioritize vulnerabilities and track remediation
  • Maintain security posture visibility across products

5. Engineering Partnership, Mentorship & Enablement

  • Work closely with developers to:
  • Explain security findings to both technical and non-technical audience
  • Recommend practical and effective fixes
  • Provide security guidance balancing usability and security, without impacting delivery
  • Deliver training and security awareness
  • Provide technical mentorship to engineers and junior AppSec team members

  • Communicate risk clearly to:
  • Engineers
  • Product managers
  • Leadership

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Security, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years in:
  • Application security
  • Software engineering with a security focus

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of application security concepts.
  • Web/application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10)
  • Secure coding practices
  • APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures
  • Hands-on experience in threat modeling and architecture reviews
  • Prior software development experience
  • Strong coding skills, preferably, C++ and Java, ability to read, write, and review code effectively
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • ASPM, SAST, DAST, and SCA tools
  • CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines
  • Advanced experience applying AI (e.g., code generation, analysis and exploitation) across secure SDLC and AppSec practices, including evaluating and mitigating security risks such as insecure code suggestions, data leakage, and supply chain exposure.

Communication & Collaboration

description:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are developing a highly scalable media intelligence platform that processes, analyzes, and structures large volumes of multimedia content across text, image, video, and audio. As a Senior Applied ML Engineer, you will architect and build the core backend systems that power media ingestion, processing workflows, metadata generation, AI-based analysis, semantic search, and retrieval across large media libraries.

We are looking for a Senior Applied ML Engineer who can design, implement, optimize, and evaluate a production-grade moderation pipeline using open-source models.

This role requires deep backend engineering expertise, strong system design capability, and practical experience integrating AI/ML systems into production workflows. You will work on complex media-processing pipelines, video/audio analysis, OCR, speech-to-text, embedding generation, vector search, multimodal model integrations, and high-throughput asynchronous workloads. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership to define backend architecture, improve reliability and scalability, and guide other engineers in delivering secure, observable, and high-performance systems.

Responsibilities

Backend Architecture & System Ownership

  • Architect, build, and operate scalable backend services for a media intelligence platform, with a focus on clean, maintainable, and production-ready systems.
  • Own critical backend components end to end, from system design and API contracts through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Drive architectural decisions across APIs, processing pipelines, distributed compute, storage, search, observability, cloud infrastructure, and model-serving workflows.
  • Design data models and storage patterns for media assets, generated metadata, embeddings, processing jobs, model outputs, search indexes, and audit trails.
  • Design high-throughput media ingestion and processing pipelines for large volumes of video, audio, image, and text content.
  • Build distributed, event-driven workflows for media processing using queues and pub/sub systems such as SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent technologies.
  • Implement reliable asynchronous processing patterns, including retries, idempotency, dead-letter queues, backpressure handling, and fault-tolerant job execution.

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

  • Lead the development and optimization of metadata extraction, content analysis, scene detection, transcription, embedding generation, and multimodal AI inference workflows.
  • Integrate and optimize AI/ML services within backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene analysis, multimodal inference, batching, caching, and fallback strategies.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers, data scientists, or external model providers to benchmark models, compare quality/latency trade-offs, and safely roll out model upgrades.

Model Serving & Performance Optimization

  • Optimize AI/ML inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost across both real-time and batch-processing paths.
  • Work with model-serving systems such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or custom inference services to improve batching, concurrency, warmup behavior, timeout handling, autoscaling, and GPU utilization.

title: Backend Software Engineer, AI Platform
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The DEX team builds eBay’s Decisioning & Execution Engine, the platform that powers automated decisions and guided judgment for Customer Service and risk workflows across online and batch channels. We provide an intuitive rules and model-based engine that evaluates billions of evaluations per year, orchestrating actions for multiple internal clients and tools.

We’re looking for a full-time software developer who will help evolve DEX into a more AI-native decisioning platform, integrating machine learning models, LLMs, and experimentation into our core flows.

What you’ll do

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs that power DEX decisioning in both real-time and batch modes.

  • Build and integrate ML- and LLM-driven decisioning components (e.g., model inference, feature computation, policy orchestration) into existing rules flows.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and rule analysts to productionize models, define interfaces, and deploy decision logic safely at scale (including A/B and canary rollouts).

  • Extend our rules and configuration framework so that policy and operations teams can safely author, test, and deploy sophisticated decisions without code changes.

  • Partner with product and partner teams (e.g., Customer Support, Risk, Trust, Billing, Returns) to translate business policies into robust, measurable technical solutions.

  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and on-call for the services you own.

You are

  • A backend engineer with strong experience in at least one strongly typed language (e.g. C#, Java or similar) and building distributed services in production.

  • Comfortable working with SQL datastores, designing schemas, and writing performant queries for high-volume flows.

  • Experienced with AI/ML in production – e.g., integrating models behind APIs, working with feature pipelines, or building inference services (Python, model-serving frameworks, etc.).

  • Familiar with (or eager to learn) LLM-based applications: prompt design, retrieval-augmented workflows, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop feedback.

  • Strong in systems thinking: you care about latency, throughput, resilience, and the blast radius of changes in high-volume decision systems.

  • Comfortable working in a highly collaborative environment with product managers, analysts, and operations partners, and explaining complex technical concepts in clear language.

Basic qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years of software development experience (or equivalent), with a focus on backend or platform engineering.

  • Experience building and owning production services (REST/JSON or gRPC) and working in CI/CD environments.

  • Experience with at least one cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.

  • Demonstrated experience integrating machine learning or advanced analytics into user- or system-facing products.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with decisioning/rules engines, workflow engines, or policy automation platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with ML/AI contexts (data pipelines, model training, evaluation, or inference).

  • Experience with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, semantic search, RAG) or prior work on AI assistants for internal tools.

  • Familiarity with customer service, risk, or trust & safety domains.

  • Experience in high-availability, multi-region services and designing for resilience, monitoring, and alerting.

Why this role

This is an opportunity to shape the next generation of eBay’s decisioning platform, bringing together rules, ML, and LLMs to drive better automation, guidance, and outcomes for customers and teammates. You’ll work on a critical, high-visibility system with strong business impact and a team that invests deeply in quality, safety, and innovation.

For over 20 years, these values have shaped a culture of growth, innovation, and support, where our team members build successful, long-term careers.

With a diverse team spread across 25 offices in 14 countries, we value collaboration, learning, and problem-solving together. We have been featured twice in The Sunday Times’ ‘100 Best Companies to Work For’ and continue to prioritize well-being, career growth, and inclusion.

Our continued success has made us the most used business data provider in the world and one of the industry’s strongest growing business intelligence providers. Today Creditsafe has 23 offices across 3 continents serving 110,000 customers from SMEs to enterprise businesses.

We test throughout the lifecycle and believe that the whole team is responsible for the quality of our deliverables. We implement intelligent automation and are proponents of thinking critically about the features developed by our teams.

You will collaborate closely with engineering and product teams from the beginning stages of development, offering input on system design and testing strategies. Your focus will be on data pipeline, API, and infrastructure testing to ensure they meet the highest standards of quality and scalability.

This is a hybrid position, requiring attendance in the office for 50% of the working week, in line with our hybrid work policy.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues within data pipelines and APIs, providing clear reports and working with the engineering team to fix them.

  • Performance Testing: Conduct performance testing on systems to identify bottlenecks and help improve performance.

We will support your learning and provide resources to help you grow in this role.


WHAT YO U BRING

  • Experience: Proven experience in software testing, especially with data pipelines and API testing in complex environments.

  • Technical Skills: Strong Python skills for test automation, and familiarity with AWS services (e.g., Redshift, S3, DynamoDB).

  • Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to understand and test complex data flows and systems.

  • Automation: Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks that integrate with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical team members.

title: Process Integration Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel Ireland is Europe's leading semiconductor manufacturing facility employing industry leading EUV patterning technology. Its newest facility, F34 opened in 2023 and began high-volume production of Intel4 and Intel3 technology. Since 1989, Intel has invested more than 30 billion in Ireland creating the most advanced industrial campus in Europe.


The Role and Impact
Join Intel Ireland's Yield Team as a Process Integration Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in driving Intel's manufacturing excellence and technological innovation. You will collaborate across diverse teams to optimize processes, improve yield, and enhance quality, driving innovations that will directly impact Intel Ireland's success. You will be at the forefront of developing process solutions and driving critical yield gain, working on some of the world's most advanced semi-conductor technologies. Your contributions will play a direct role in enabling the Ireland site to continue as critical in Intel's success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute experiments to characterize processes and improve performance, ensuring seamless integration in high-volume manufacturing.

  • Identifying parametric related signals, initiating/leading teams to understand issues, and following through root cause closure.

  • Identify and resolve process integration challenges by using root cause analysis techniques and developing innovative solutions in collaboration with Product Engineering, Device, Defect Reduction and Module Engineering teams.

  • Develop and drive engineering projects to improve yield, quality, performance and to reduce cost.

  • Leverage data analysis to identify process and manufacturing issues and devise corrective, data-driven solutions.

  • Support New Product Introduction (NPIs) by following rigorous product implementation and testing strategies.

  • Support our customers by identifying, containing and de-risking quality events and communicating findings.

  • You will work closely with VF (virtual factory) counterparts, Process Engineering, Low Yield Analysis, Product Engineering and Quality and Reliability teams to meet yield targets and solve complex technological problems.

  • Bachelor's degree NFQ Level 8 in Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in statistical data analysis tools such as JMP, MATLAB, or Python.

  • Demonstrated experience in project execution, including design of experiments (DOE) and process improvement.

  • Experience in statistical methods and engineering analysis tools.

  • Strong technical expertise and leadership abilities.

  • Self driven individual, comfortable operating in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with shifting priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD in Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field (both fresh graduates and experienced candidates are welcome to apply).

  • Knowledge of device physics and high volume manufacturing or wafer fabrication processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data from multiple sources into actionable insights.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the capability to convey complex technical concepts to multidisciplinary teams.

  • Demonstrated experience in semiconductor process engineering, equipment engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Programming/scripting experience (Python, SQL, JMP, or similar) for large scale data analysis.

Experienced Hire

Shift 1 (Ireland)

Ireland, Leixlip

title: GPU Performance Verification Engineer - Cork, Ireland
description:
Company:

QT Technologies Ireland Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary:

About the Role

We are hiring a GPU Performance Verification Engineer to join our team in Cork, focused on verifying and optimising the performance of next-generation Adreno GPUs —central to Qualcomm’s Snapdragon platforms, including the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite and Snapdragon X Elite . This role is pivotal in ensuring our GPUs deliver industry-leading performance across gaming, compute, and AI workloads, while maintaining power efficiency and architectural scalability.

Why This Role Matters

The Adreno GPU is a cornerstone of Qualcomm’s graphics innovation. With the launch of Snapdragon X Elite , Adreno entered the high-performance compute space, delivering up to 4.6 TFLOPS of GPU compute and supporting real-time ray tracing , 240 FPS mobile gaming , and AI-powered graphics enhancements

The sliced architecture enables independent shader processor-based cores, improving concurrency and work distribution.

In mobile, the newly launched Snapdragon 8 Elite —formerly known as Gen 4—marks a major leap forward. It integrates the 2nd Gen Qualcomm Oryon CPU and Adreno 830 GPU , delivering over 30% performance uplift compared to Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 . The platform supports Unreal Engine 5.3 , Nanite , and Chaos Physics , enabling film-quality 3D environments and lifelike object interactions on smartphones

AI Leadership in Adreno GPUs:

Adreno GPUs are now tightly integrated with Qualcomm’s AI Engine , enabling real-time, on-device AI use cases across vision, language, and audio. The Snapdragon 8 Elite delivers up to 45% faster AI performance , supporting multi-modal GenAI workloads such as:

  • Real-time semantic segmentation for camera enhancements.

  • AI-powered ray tracing and denoising for immersive gaming.

  • Low-latency translation and voice interaction on-device

We are hiring across multiple roles with new college grads and experienced candidates.

What This Role involves:

This role centers on verifying the performance of Adreno GPUs powering flagship Snapdragon platforms. You’ll work on:

  • Identifying and resolving architectural bottlenecks in GPU pipelines.

  • Collaborate closely with GPU Design and Architecture teams to understand graphics concepts, performance trade-offs and propose optimizations

  • Evaluate and optimize advanced GPU features such as ray tracing, context switching, and AI acceleration to ensure peak performance and efficiency

  • Driving performance closure using trending graphics, compute, and AI benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

  • Leverage Python-based data analytics to extract insights from large-scale simulation and emulation datasets.

  • Collaborating across hardware and software teams to optimize power, performance, and area (PPA).

  • Ensure compatibility and performance of AAA games across current and next-gen gaming systems

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field

Strong foundation in Computer ,GPU architecture, caches , memory subsystem etc

Strong analytical skills

Desirable:

  • ASIC Design and/or Verification with a strong foundation in System Verilog/UVM.

  • Experience with UVM-based verification environments desirable.

  • Proficiency in any of the simulation or emulation platforms for design exploration and debug.

  • 4+ years of overall experience in CPU/GPU/NPU domains(for experienced roles)

  • Familiarity with simulation acceleration and emulation platforms.

  • Experience in SW/HW partitioning and analyzing performance issues across the stack.

  • Expertise in data visualization and analytics using Python.

Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.
There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.

title: Junior Data Operations Analyst
description: We are bringing on a Junior Data Operations Analyst to support our current engagement with an international financial services partner. Much of this work involves the heavy lifting of data: making sure information flows correctly between their existing internal systems and the new tools we are building for them. You will be helping us keep their databases clean and their automated reports running accurately. This is a full-time, fully remote position where you will focus on the practical details of data management and integrity. About Pixel Systems We are a small, remote software agency that builds the tools teams actually use. We do not spend our time on flashy marketing sites or the latest tech fads. Instead, we focus on the practical stuff: admin panels, CRM integrations, and the database migrations that people usually try to avoid. Our clients come to us because we are straightforward. We provide fixed quotes, show our work every week through demos, and hand over everything (the code, the documentation, and walkthrough videos) when we are finished. We use reliable, well-tested technologies like Node, React, and Postgres because we want the software we build to be stable and easy to maintain. The role As a Junior Data Operations Analyst, your day is mostly about the data itself. You will be working with our developers to map out how information should move from one system to another. Sometimes that means writing scripts to clean up messy spreadsheets so they can be imported into a database without errors. Other times, it means checking that an API integration is correctly pulling financial records. You will spend a lot of time looking at database tables, identifying inconsistencies, and fixing them. It is not high-profile work, but it is the work that ensures the systems we build are actually useful for our financial services partner. Since we are a remote shop, you will spend your time in our task management tools and document everything you do so the rest of the team stays in the loop. What we are looking for We need someone who is organized and enjoys the process of getting data in order. Since this is an entry-level role, you do not need years of professional experience, but you should be the kind of person who double-checks their own work and pays attention to small details (like whether a date format is consistent across a file). You should be comfortable working on your own while staying connected with our team through written communication. Being able to explain why a data error happened in plain English is more important to us than knowing every complex database query. We value people who are happy to dig into a boring spreadsheet to find a broken link because they know it matters for the final product. Helpful background While we will help you get up to speed, it is useful if you have a bit of experience with a few basic tools. These are not strict requirements, but they will help you get started: A general understanding of how databases work, specifically SQL-based systems like Postgres. Experience using GitHub to manage projects or track changes in your work. Basic knowledge of how APIs work to move data between different software programs. Some familiarity with JavaScript or Node, as these are the primary tools we use. The ability to use Excel or Google Sheets for more than just basic lists. A preference for simple, working solutions over complex ones. Working at Pixel Systems Working here is different from a typical corporate job. We are a small team without layers of middle management. You will work directly with our senior developers and see how software projects are handled from start to finish. We value work that is finished and functional. Because we are a fully remote team, we rely heavily on clear writing and regular check-ins. The position is paid, and we offer a salary that is competitive for the role and the current market. There are no frantic all-nighters or sudden changes in direction here. We plan our work, we stick to the schedule, and we ship tools that solve real operational headaches for our partners.  We are more interested in your ability to learn and your attention to detail than a long list of previous jobs. We build software that supports the day-to-day operations of businesses, and that requires a steady hand and a focus on accuracy. If you like the idea of working in a small, quiet, and deliberate environment where the goal is to build things that work, you will fit in well here. We focus on getting the job done right so that our clients can stop worrying about their data and get back to their own work.

Your work will directly impact the security, performance, and efficiency of compute infrastructure serving millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain hypervisor and VMM components in Rust, including virtual device emulation, memory management, and vCPU scheduling.
  • Optimize boot latency, memory footprint, and I/O throughput for ephemeral microVM workloads at global scale.
  • Harden the security boundary between guest and host, contributing to threat modeling and implementing isolation mechanisms.
  • Contribute to the upstream Linux kernel where needed to support Firecracker's roadmap.
  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, drive code quality through reviews, and champion best practices.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to ensure operational excellence of Firecracker-based services.

A day in the life
Your day might start by reviewing pull requests on the Firecracker open-source repository, providing feedback to community contributors or teammates. You then dive into implementing a new virtio device or optimizing a hot path in the VMM, writing Rust and reasoning about memory safety and performance trade-offs. After lunch, you collaborate with an internal AWS service team that consumes Firecracker to debug a subtle guest-host interaction - perhaps a vCPU scheduling anomaly or an unexpected memory mapping behavior. You wrap up by writing a design doc for an upcoming kernel interface change, getting input from colleagues across the team. Throughout the day, you balance deep technical work with collaboration, working in the open on GitHub alongside a global community.

About the team
We are the Compute Capsule team within AWS Lambda, based in Dublin, Ireland. We own Firecracker end-to-end - from its open-source development on GitHub to its deployment at scale inside AWS. We focus on serverless and container virtualization, trusted compute, and server fleet tooling. We value work-life balance, respect each other's time, and invest in growing every team member through mentorship, challenging assignments, and training. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and actively seek team players who thrive in collaborative, inclusive environments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
  • Hands-on experience with low-level systems programming (e.g., kernel, hypervisor, firmware, or embedded systems)
  • Proficiency in at least one systems language: C, C++, or Rust
  • Solid understanding of Linux internals (syscalls, memory management, process Experience with virtualization technologies (KVM, Xen, QEMU, or similar)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Rust in production systems
  • Contributions to open-source projects (kernel, hypervisor, or systems tooling)
  • Experience with device emulation or virtio
  • Familiarity with hardware-assisted virtualization (Intel VT-x, AMD-V, or Arm virtualization extensions)
  • Knowledge of performance profiling and optimization at the systems level (perf, ftrace, eBPF)
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Graduate Quality Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.


What You Can Expect


The Graduate Quality Engineer is a structured 24-month development role designed to build core capability in quality engineering, quality systems and cross-functional project support within Zimmer Biomet. The role holder will be based in Shannon for 18 months and will complete a 6- month rotation in the Galway site to gain wider operational exposure. Through coached assignments and formal training, the graduate will develop practical knowledge of manufacturing quality, non-conformance management, CAPA, internal and external risk management, audit readiness and project execution while supporting compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

How You'll Create Impact


  • Support quality engineering and quality systems activities to help ensure products and processes conform to established requirements and standards.
  • Assist with the development, review and maintenance of procedures, specifications, forms and quality records in line with site requirements.
  • Participate in investigations relating to non-conformances, quality issues, complaints or process deviations and support timely follow-through of resulting actions.
  • Support CAPA activities, including problem definition, root-cause analysis, action tracking, effectiveness review and closure support.
  • Assist with risk management activities for both internal and external issues, including participation in risk assessments and updates to associated documentation as required.
  • Support validation, inspection planning, data collection and trending activities to help monitor process and product quality performance.
  • Compile, analyse and present quality data to support decision-making, continuous improvement and project reporting.
  • Contribute to audit preparation and follow-up activities and, as capability develops, participate in internal audit activities under guidance.
  • Work with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain and other support functions on quality-related projects and improvement initiatives.
  • Complete the planned Shannon-to-Galway site rotation and apply learnings across both site environments.
  • Maintain training compliance and complete the structured development plan associated with the graduate programme.
  • Perform other quality-related duties consistent with the level and developmental nature of the role.

What Makes You Stand Out


  • Strong interpersonal, communication and learning agility skills.
  • Demonstrated interest in quality, compliance, manufacturing or regulated industry environments.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving capability, with attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and build relationships across functions and sites.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to learn quality system requirements, audit principles, CAPA methodology and risk management tools.
  • Ability to organise work, manage deadlines and respond positively to coaching and feedback.

Your Background


  • Recent graduate, or expected to graduate before programme start, with a third-level qualification in Quality, Engineering, Science or a related discipline.
  • Relevant placement, internship, project or academic experience in a manufacturing, medical device, pharmaceutical or other regulated environment would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Demonstrated motivation to pursue a career in quality engineering within a regulated industry environment.

Travel Expectations


  • Occasional inter-site travel as required for training and project support

title: Graduate Ecologist - Cork
description:
Roughan & O’Donovan (ROD) is looking to recruit a graduate ecologist for a permanent position within our expanding environment and ecology team. The role will be based in our Cork office

Job type: Permanent

Location: Cork

Salary: Competitive

About the role

You will work in an integrated team of ecologists, environmental scientists, planners and engineers, assisting in the assessment and delivery of a range of projects, including roads, greenways, buildings and bridges.

You will get involved in the ecological and biodiversity aspects of plans and infrastructure and conservation projects.

Key aspects of the role include undertaking field surveys and technical reporting.

Current projects:

  • BusConnects Cork
  • Cork Area Commuter Rail (CACR) Phase Two
  • West Cork Greenway – Skibbereen Sections
  • Fáilte Ireland Environmental Monitoring
  • Waterford City Public Infrastructure Project
  • Barnesmore Gap Greenway
  • N25 Midleton to Youghal
  • Irish National Heritage Park

Essential

  • Degree in ecology or a related biological/environmental science subject with an ecological component (Level 8 qualification in the National Framework of Qualifications or equivalent)
  • Good field skills and a keen interest and understanding of Irish wildlife
  • Excellent report writing skills
  • Hard-working and highly motivated
  • Demonstrated field survey experience in ecology e.g. habitat classification (Fossitt), badger, otter, bat, bird and invasive species surveys
  • Client-focused with good interpersonal skills and a team approach
  • Physically fit and willing to undertake fieldwork in remote areas and in all weather conditions
  • Excellent communication and IT skills, with the ability to record data efficiently and methodically
  • Fluency/high level of proficiency in spoken and written English
  • Full clean driving licence
  • Membership of the Chartered Institute of Ecology and Environmental Management (CIEEM) or working towards membership

Desirable

  • Relevant volunteering experience
  • A postgraduate qualification in a relevant ecological discipline that includes practical experience
  • Familiarity with relevant Irish and European legislation, such as the Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, EIA Directive, Birds and Natural Habitats Regulations
  • Experience using GIS systems, such as ArcGIS, QGIS and/or others

About Roughan & O'Donovan

Roughan & O'Donovan (ROD) is a leading civil, environmental and structural engineering consultancy. An independently owned firm, we employ a multidisciplinary team of more than 250 people, of 20 different nationalities, across our Dublin, Cork and UK offices.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

PostgreSQL Database Engineer (with Software Engineering Expertise)

Location: Dublin, Ireland
Job Type: Full-time

About the team and the role

We are seeking a Senior PostgreSQL Database Engineer with strong software engineering expertise to design, optimize, and scale eBay’s database platforms while also contributing to backend development and automation tooling.

This is a hands-on engineering role that bridges data infrastructure and software systems — ideal for someone passionate about both PostgreSQL internals and building scalable, reliable services. You will collaborate closely with product, platform, and SRE teams to ensure our data infrastructure delivers performance, resilience, and compliance at global scale.

What you will accomplish

  • Design and implement scalable, highly available PostgreSQL architectures, including replication, partitioning, and disaster recovery.

  • Improve query performance, indexing strategies, and database configurations following PostgreSQL guidelines.

  • Develop tools and services to automate provisioning, monitoring, and deployment of databases and related systems.

  • Implement and maintain strong database security standards, including role-based access control and encryption.

  • Collaborate with software, DevOps, and analytics teams to integrate PostgreSQL solutions with applications and pipelines.

  • Mentor engineers and implement guidelines for schema development, tuning, and database operations.

What you will bring

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience managing PostgreSQL in large-scale production environments.

  • Strong programming proficiency in C/C++, Python, Go, or Java, with experience building automation or backend tools.

  • Expertise in SQL and PL/pgSQL, with a deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals and performance tuning.

  • Experience with Linux/Unix, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments (Docker).

  • Proven knowledge of replication, backup, and migration strategies, including cross-platform migrations (e.g., Oracle PostgreSQL).

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Location and work model

This role follows eBay’s hybrid model, requiring three days per week in the Dublin office (unless otherwise stated).

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. title: Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs - Pricing & Underwriting
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs - Pricing & Underwriting, will provide regulatory leadership and subject‑matter expertise in support of Optum Rx Pricing & Underwriting activities. This role is responsible for interpreting, assessing, and operationalizing complex federal and state regulatory requirements, ensuring pricing and underwriting strategies remain compliant, defensible, and aligned with evolving regulatory expectations.

In this role you will partner closely with actuarial, finance, underwriting, legal, compliance, and product teams to evaluate regulatory impacts on business initiatives, develop clear guidance, and influence decision‑making. The role will lead regulatory analyses and proactively monitor regulatory developments that may affect pricing methodologies, underwriting practices, and product design.

This position requires strong analytical judgment, the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business solutions, and the leadership skills to guide stakeholders through ambiguity. The Associate Director will also contribute to governance forums, support risk assessments, and help shape the regulatory strategy for Optum Rx Pricing & Underwriting.


Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide regulatory leadership and subject‑matter expertise in support of Optum Rx Pricing & Underwriting activities

  • Interpret and assess federal and state regulatory requirements impacting pricing methodologies, underwriting practices, and product design

  • Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for actuarial, pricing, underwriting, and business partners

  • Partner cross‑functionally with Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, Product, and Operations teams to ensure regulatory compliance across initiatives

  • Lead regulatory impact assessments for new products, pricing strategies, and underwriting models

  • Monitor and evaluate emerging regulatory developments, proactively assessing business risk and operational impact

  • Contribute to governance forums and risk management processes, including issue escalation and mitigation strategies

  • Develop and maintain regulatory documentation, interpretations, and internal guidance materials

  • Mentor junior analysts and influence best practices for regulatory analysis and decision‑making within Pricing & Underwriting


You will be rewarded and recognised for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial, business, economics, health policy, law, or a related field

  • Proven experience in regulatory analysis, compliance, actuarial, pricing, underwriting, or a related healthcare or pharmacy benefit environment

  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying complex regulations impacting pricing and underwriting

  • Proven ability to work cross‑functionally with actuarial, legal, compliance, product, and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a regulatory focused discipline

  • Prior experience within a pharmacy benefit manager (PBM)

  • Experience supporting pricing and underwriting activities for complex or regulated healthcare products

  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare regulatory environments relevant to pharmacy, pricing, and underwriting

  • Experience participating in or presenting to regulatory, governance, or risk committees

  • Prior experience mentoring or leading analysts in a matrixed organization


Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.

The Revenue Accounting Analyst I plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of revenue recognition across Graebel Companies Inc.'s diverse portfolio of domestic and international client accounts. Job Overview:
Job Purpose


This role is the Finance Business Partner for Content Tech, responsible for owning the end-to-end budget and forecasting cycle, delivering insightful management reporting, and acting as a trusted finance partner to divisional leadership. Working alongside the Senior Finance Business Partner, this position drives financial performance through rigorous analysis, variance investigation, and forward-looking financial planning across the CT product portfolio.


The role also ensures the accuracy of transactional postings, including revenue recognition, and works in partnership with the Shared Service Centre and Group Controllership to improve processes and strengthen controls. You will contribute to strategic projects such as M&A activity and three-year planning, making this a role that combines hands-on financial management with commercial and strategic exposure.


Key Responsibilities


Budget and Forecasting

  • Own the end-to-end budget and forecast process for Content Tech, partnering with product and commercial stakeholders to build credible, well-evidenced financial plans

  • Prepare and maintain rolling forecasts, ensuring assumptions are clearly documented and regularly challenged against actuals

  • Coordinate divisional submissions into the Group planning cycle, including the annual budget, quarterly reforecasts, and three-year plan inputs

  • Build and maintain financial models across the CT product portfolio to support scenario analysis, investment cases, and resource allocation decisions

  • Track forecast accuracy over time and implement improvements to the forecasting methodology where gaps are identified


Reporting, Analysis, and Variance Investigation

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting packs for divisional leadership, with clear commentary on performance against forecast

  • Identify, investigate, and explain variances across revenue, cost, and margin lines, distinguishing between timing, mix, and underlying performance drivers

  • Develop and maintain KPI dashboards that give leadership a real-time view of commercial and financial performance

  • Support the preparation of Board and ELT materials, ensuring figures are accurate, internally consistent, and clearly presented


Transactional Accuracy and Revenue Recognition

  • Review transactional data posted by the SSC and Commercial Analyst, including revenue recognition entries, to ensure accuracy and completeness

  • Oversee the correct application of revenue recognition policies across licence types (perpetual, term, SaaS) in line with IFRS 15 and Group policy

  • Liaise with Financial Controllers and the SSC on any queries arising during close, ensuring the division meets its close timetable obligations

  • Be the first point of contact for audit queries relating to the Content Tech division, coordinating responses and gathering supporting evidence as required


Automation and Process Improvement

  • Identify and drive opportunities to automate repetitive financial processes, reducing manual effort and error rates

  • Partner with the SSC, Group Controllership, and Master Data teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and process standardisation

  • Document in-scope finance processes and maintain up-to-date records in the assigned shared location

  • Support Group-led initiatives such as system migrations, tool rollouts, or process redesign exercises a

title: Social Impact Analyst - 1 Year - Maternity Cover
description:
Rethink Ireland

Social Impact Analyst
(Funds delivery support role)


Contract: 1 Year Fixed Term Maternity Cover Contract

Based: Dublin, Cork or Galway - with some travel within Ireland

Benefits: 23 days Annual Leave.

Employer pension

Hybrid (With the opportunity to work from home & flexible working)

Salary: €35,000 per annum


We’re looking for a Social Impact Analyst to support all stages of the Fund Pathway — from Fund Scoping, Open Call & Selection, to Programme Design & Delivery, through to Awardee Performance Management and Sustainability & Exit Planning.


Although the role sits within social impact work, it is primarily an administrative and coordination-focused role. A large part of the day-to-day work involves keeping processes organised, preparing documents, updating trackers, scheduling meetings, following up with stakeholders, and helping ensure fund activity moves forward smoothly and on time.


What does a typical day look like?


  • Support the coordination meetings and the delivery of key fund milestones
  • Support fund team to strengthen performance and impact of awardees
  • Collecting and analysing data to feed into reports and donor updates
  • Supporting programme planning, tracking fund budgets, and managing documentation
  • Collaborating across teams to keep each Fund running smoothly from start to finish

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________


ROLE PURPOSE

The purpose of this role is to develop and deliver the social impact of Rethink Ireland by supporting a portfolio of awardees to meet programme targets, driving maximum achievement of social impact, in line with investment objectives and conditions. Monitoring impact metrics is a key aspect of this role. It is a critical relationship management role with both applicants and awardees.


JOB DESCRIPTION

This role will work across our portfolio of funds and awardees. The successful candidate will report to a Manager within the Operations Team and work closely with the Portfolio Management Team and other business units, including Marketing Communications, Finance and Business Development Teams, to drive and deliver Rethink Ireland's impact.


Core duties:

  • You will support the call for applications and selection process of applicants for new Funds including Fund promotion and the recruitment of applications as well as lead on due diligence processes.
  • You will work within the Portfolio Management team, taking a leadership role in some areas and an execution or support role in others, in order to develop strong awardee relationships and deliver maximum awardee performance.
  • You will work with the awardees supporting the definition of their social impact goals, assisting the Fund Manager/Associate Fund Manager with building the capacity of the projects to deliver the promised impact, and supporting managing the input of the non-financial supports.
  • Administrative tasks such as supporting grant payments, consolidating Fund budgets and keeping track of Fund expenditure.
  • You will support the development and delivery of capacity-building programmes for awardees.
  • You will support the management of the investment relationship with relevant Rethink Ireland awardees, including performance management.
  • You will support the successful close-out of funds as assigned by your line manager, including completing donor reporting on time and working closely with the Marketing and Communications Team.
  • You will design, collect, analyse and verify impact data, identifying trends and producing social impact reports, both statistical and visual
  • You will support the implementation of social impact and portfolio management systems including financial reporting
  • You will support the coordination between suppliers, consultants, awardees and Rethink Ireland

title: Associate Sales Operations Analyst
description:

Job Description

Associate Scientist, Cell & Molecular Biology

At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralised clinical trial services.

Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Location/Division Specific Information

Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations

Discover Impactful Work:

Associate Scientist in the Cell & Molecular biology lab performs a variety of routine to complex sample preparation and analysis procedures to quantitatively measure pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical compounds in a variety of formulations and/or biological matrices. Follows validated or experimental analytical procedures with periodic direct supervision. Responsible for review and compilation of results and data comparison against SOP acceptance criteria, methodology, protocol and product specifications.

Our Assistant Scientist and Associate Scientist positions both fall under the working title of 'Scientist I'. While the title is the same, there are different levels of experience required. Our Assistant role is a graduate position with no previous experience needed, our Associate Scientist position requires 1 years industry experience OR a PhD.

A day in the Life

  • Performs a variety of routine to complex sample preparation and analysis procedures to quantitatively measure pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical compounds in a variety of formulations and/or biological matrices for stability and analytical testing.
  • Problem solves with assistance pertaining to extraction and/or instrumentation problems.
  • Trains on routine operation, maintenance and theory of analytical instrumentation, SOPs and regulatory procedures and guidelines.
  • Manages QC/QA responsibilities without supervisor or QA input.
  • Communicates project status to project leader.
  • Performs work assignments accurately, and in a timely and safe manner.
  • Reviews, interprets, and analyzes data for technical, quality and compliance to protocols, methods, SOPs, client criteria and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) or Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Performs self and peer review of the data for accuracy and compliance with reporting requirements prior to submission to QA and issuance to customers.

Kepak Operational Rotational Graduate Programme 2026 - Ireland

We are seeking to recruit for the 2065 Operational Rotational Graduate Programme across the following Kepak locations in Ireland:

  • Watergrasshill, Co.Cork

Role Purpose

The Operations Graduate will embark on an intensive learning journey within our meat processing company, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the entire production process from procurement to sales. This role is designed to develop future leaders in the meat industry, with a strong emphasis on learning the end-to-end process of deconstructing an animal, understanding the value of each part, and mastering the operations that drive our business. The ultimate goal is for the graduate to be able to articulate the entire process, from purchasing a live animal to delivering finished products to customers, and to demonstrate this knowledge through presentations and hands-on experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Process Learning: Rotate through various departments, including procurement, abattoir, by-product processing, warehouse, logistics, and sales, to gain hands-on experience and a deep understanding of each stage of the meat production process.
  • Presentation and Reporting: At the end of each rotation, present the acquired knowledge and insights to demonstrate an understanding of the operations. This includes explaining the deconstruction of the animal and the value of its parts.
  • Operational Involvement: Actively participate on the factory floor, learning each work station and the processes involved in breaking down the animal into prime and customer-specific cuts.
  • People Management: Develop skills in managing diverse teams, understanding the dynamics of a labour-intensive industry, and learning how to effectively communicate and lead in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in key projects such as data gathering, writing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process improvement initiatives, and customer-specific projects to contribute to the overall efficiency of operations.

Key Competencies

  • Numerical Proficiency: Strong aptitude for working with numbers, crucial for understanding the yield, value, and financial aspects of meat processing.
  • Work Ethic: A strong work ethic is essential. Demonstrating a background in farming, manual labour, or consistent part-time work during studies is an advantage.
  • People Management: Ability to manage and motivate teams in a labour-intensive environment, with a focus on maintaining calm and effective communication in high-pressure situations.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills, particularly in high-pressure environments where quick thinking and decision-making are required.
  • Teamwork: Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, whether through sports, work, or academic projects.

Other Role Information

  • Location: Full-time on-site at our various processing plants, with the possibility of travel to other locations for specialized learning.
  • Progression: The program will involve 90% factory floor experience and 10% office-based work initially, with a gradual increase in office responsibilities as the graduate progresses.
  • Assessment: The graduate will be assessed through presentations and practical demonstrations of their understanding at each stage of the process. You will also have a Learner Journey to support your progress, this states key competencies that we want you to develop through your programme

Our Graduate programme allows dynamic, motivated, hardworking, and passionate Graduates an opportunity start their career with one of Ireland & UKs leading meat businesses. The programme lasts 2 years.

description:

Arcadis works at the frontier of facility delivering innovative and ground-breaking solutions for our clients on the most exciting and high-profile projects around the world, designing some of the most complex and specialized facilities under construction today. If you have what it takes to work with us, apply today.

Role Summary

Industrial Hygiene Scope

Co-ordination, continuous improvement and management of specific Industrial Hygiene (IH) programs onsite which may also involve close liaison with Safety/Industrial Hygiene engineers. Examples of site IH programs include hearing conservation, ionising and non-ionising radiation, ppe and ventilation. In addition you will support the overall EHS management system and OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 standards which will involve close liaison with EHS engineers. Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:


  • Conducting IH risk assessments and associated employee and/or area exposure monitoring for both physical and chemical hazards.
  • Supporting IH surveys associated with our Equipment Sign Off (ESO) program.
  • Act as the content expert in relation to assigned IH programs.
  • Support accident/incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance to regulatory requirements and internal standards.
  • Analyze data, identify trends and define focus areas.

Environmental Scope:

Responsible for the development, co-ordination, continuous improvement and management of site environmental programmes, in particular wastewater, and potentially support other programmes such as air emissions, noise, refrigerants, groundwater and management systems. Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Playing a key role in ensuring compliance with the site’s Industrial Emissions Licence and ISO14001 standard. This includes review of compliance results/trends, Env Mgt System elements including awareness/training, documentation, Environmental Management Programme projects etc., incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Understand how all environmental programmes work by supporting all Environmental Engineers at the site with a view to becoming a primary owner for some environmental programme(s), with additional responsibility as secondary owner for other programmes.

Safety Scope:

Co-ordination, continuous improvement and management of specific safety programs onsite which may also involve close liaison with Safety engineers. Examples of site safety programs include Powered Industrial Trucks, Working at Heights etc. In addition you will support the overall EHS management system and OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 standards which will involve close liaison with EHS engineers. Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:


  • Conducting safety risk assessments
  • Act as the content expert in relation to assigned safety programs.
  • Support accident/incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance to regulatory requirements and internal standards.
  • Analyze data, identify trends and define focus areas.

Minimum Qualifications:

A minimum of a NFQ Level 7 qualification related to the role (e.g. environmental sciences, sustainability, chemical engineering, environmental health & safety, sciences) or have completed either a Post. Grad. Diploma or MSc. related to the role. Level 8 qualification is preferable.

Preferred requirements

  • 3+ years’ work experience related to the role is beneficial.
  • Ability to work in a team with minimum direction. Self-motivator with own initiative.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to present and explain environmental information to a broad audience of both technical and non-technical people.
  • Excellent English - written and verbal
  • Knowledge of some of the EHS areas mentioned above.
  • A high tolerance for ambiguity and change due to the dynamic nature of the business.
  • Demonstrate efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate excellent attention to detail
  • Willingness to build and foster a strong EHS culture
