title: Compliance Analyst
description:
At Paymentology, we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer-processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale - across more than 60 countries.

Our advanced, multi-cloud platform delivers real-time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

Role Summary

The Compliance Analyst is responsible for managing the AML and KYC requirements, while supporting the business in identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial crime risk. This role focuses on implementing and maintaining a robust compliance risk management system, with emphasis on AML, client onboarding, anti-corruption, and conflict of interests.

The Compliance Analyst ensures that procedures and controls are properly implemented in business processes and oversees key Compliance risks through comprehensive monitoring and testing. Additionally, the role involves overseeing relationships with partner banks, implementing new controls, interpreting and operationalising compliance requirements and supporting the Senior Compliance & Data Protection Manager in executing effective compliance programmes, and risk management practices across all levels of Paymentology.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Assessment and Mitigation

  • Conduct risk assessment for new clients, vendors, products and market entries to identify and mitigate compliance risks.

  • Manage ongoing AML, sanctions screening, KYC, and due diligence checks, ensuring compliance with South African and international regulations.

  • Implement and maintain an agile compliance risk management system based on recognised standards.

  • Ensure alignment with Paymentology's risk appetite and compliance with relevant laws and regulations, particularly in the AML/KYC space.

Reporting and Documentation

  • Prepare accurate reports and documentation for senior management, regulatory bodies, and internal and external stakeholders to demonstrate robust compliance controls.

  • Establish systems for maintaining accurate records of compliance activities, including documentation of policies, training sessions, and supporting audits, reviews and investigations.

  • Coordinate completion of compliance-related due diligence questionnaires, requested by clients during onboarding and as needed.

  • Support Paymentology's third-party risk management process and due diligence efforts for new and existing clients.

  • Maintain the Enhanced Due Diligence process and records.

Investigating Issues

  • Support investigations of complaints, incidents, allegations, or potential violations of compliance standards, and take appropriate corrective actions as necessary.

  • Identify root causes of compliance issues and breaches and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

Supporting Operations

  • Ensure day-to-day operations adhere to relevant compliance standards and policies.

  • Identify areas for improvement and implement corrective measures as needed.

  • Keep abreast of changes in laws, regulations, and industry standards relevant to Paymentology's operations and implement necessary changes to maintain compliance.

  • Conduct research on regulatory and compliance requirements in different regions of operation, with a focus on AML/KYC regulations.

  • Update internal teams on relevant changes and implications for the organisation.

  • Support the business in complying with frameworks, processes, and best practices.

  • Communicate compliance policies and procedures to ensure that team members understand their obligations and responsibilities.

  • Lead on special projects, such as implementing compliance tools, systems and ensure effective change management.

Managing Compliance Audits

  • Perform regular reviews and assessments to evaluate the effectiveness of compliance programmes and identify areas for improvement or corrective action.

  • Coordinate and drive compliance reviews conducted by external parties.

  • Liaise with multiple teams within Paymentology to collect and review necessary documentation and samples.

Providing Training and Guidance

  • Deliver training sessions and workshops to educate staff members on compliance requirements, ethical standards, and expected best practices.

  • Support the development and rollout of the annual learning program in both in-person and e-learning formats.

  • Provide guidance on compliance-related inquiries and issues.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of compliance efforts with overall business objectives.

  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with Alliance partner banks to address compliance-related issues and support their compliance requirements.

  • Negotiate solutions that align with both company and external party requirements.

  • Perform reviews for new market entries, product development, and anti-financial crimes programs (e.g. gifts and entertainment approval).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilitie

title: Analyst, Global Fees Management
description:
About Northern Trust


As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.


Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.


With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.



Role/ Department:

This is a role for a Fee Analyst within an established International Finance Operations team. The successful individual will be based in Limerick and will report to a local Ireland Fees Team Leader.

The team is responsible for the timely capture, recognition, billing and collection of revenue for multiple legal entities across EMEA. This role will include primary responsibility for a number of high profile clients. The role involves working with all areas of the Business to ensure that all fee arrangements are properly reflected in our legal books. The team has visibility and liaison with high profile clients, Client Services, Business Operations teams and Financial Control.

The key responsibilities of the role include:

  • Responsible for timely and accurate client billing across Northern Trust entities working to strict reporting deadlines.

  • Initial set-up and ongoing maintenance of client static data, ensuring correct interpretation of documented arrangements.

  • Collection of fee debtors in on a timely basis in line with agreed company and client authorised procedures including generation of payment instructions and banking entries.

  • Responsible for timely completion of accruals as part of the month-end close process to ensure revenue is accurate and complete to meet the requirements and deadlines of Financial Accounting and their month-end close schedule.

  • Work with the New Business, Client Services, and Operations Teams to ensure all new / terminated business is captured in full, correctly accrued and invoiced within agreed timelines for assigned Clients.

  • Timely communication and escalation of billing delays / issues.

  • Regular liaison and development of strong relationships with Client Services and the Business.

  • Responsibility for Client / Business / Finance queries ensuring timely resolution, documentation and escalation.

  • Ensure adherence to SOX and audit requirements. Continually improve and strengthen controls.

  • Input to fee related internal & external audits.

  • Participate as Subject Matter Expert in all fees related changes and projects.

Skills/ Qualifications:

The successful candidate will benefit from having:

  • Meticulous attention to detail with an ability to work in a fast paced environment where month end financial reporting deadlines and compliance with documented controls and processes are paramount.

  • Highly numerate with strong analytical skills.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to assess issues, identify solutions and problem solve on a timely basis.

  • Ability to partner effectively with peers, management, business and overseas partners.

  • Flexible approach towards changing work methods, deadlines and variable workloads.

  • Advanced level of IT skills notably MS Excel.


Work Authorization


Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.


Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.


Working with Us


As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.


Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.


Reasonable Accommodation


Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Commercial Analyst
description:
Commercial Analyst


About VIOTAS

VIOTAS is a leading smart grid technology company enabling large energy users to provide flexibility to electricity grids while generating additional revenue from their participation in energy markets. As renewable energy penetration increases globally, grid flexibility is becoming essential to the future of power systems. VIOTAS combines proprietary technology, market expertise and operational capability to help customers unlock this value at scale.

Recognised internationally for innovation and growth, VIOTAS plays a critical role in building a sustainable energy future and was named Ireland’s fastest-growing technology company at the Deloitte Fast 50 Awards in 2019.


Role purpose

VIOTAS is currently looking for a Commercial Analyst. The Commercial Analyst will report to and support the Director of International Operations in building a more disciplined, data-led and scalable commercial function as VIOTAS enters its next phase of international growth.

This newly created role will provide high-quality analysis, decision support and commercial coordination across pricing, pipeline quality, market prioritisation, customer segmentation, deal economics, forecasting and commercial governance.

Working closely with the Director of International Operations and other internal stakeholders, the Commercial Analyst will help ensure VIOTAS’ commercial decisions are supported by robust data, clear assumptions, strong economic logic and disciplined follow-through.

The role is suited to someone with strong commercial instincts, excellent analytical capability, high execution standards and a practical, AI-native approach to improving how commercial work is done.


Key responsibilities

  • Support the Director of International Operations with high-quality commercial analysis across pricing, market opportunity, customer segmentation, deal economics, pipeline performance, forecasting, revenue performance and commercial prioritisation.
  • Maintain clear visibility of the commercial pipeline across markets, including opportunity stage, customer segment, MW capacity, value, probability, expected timing, risks, next actions and ownership.
  • Support CRM management and CRM hygiene by helping ensure commercial data is accurate, complete, consistently updated and fit for forecasting, sales reporting, management review and decision-making.
  • Work collaboratively with sales and in-market commercial teams to strengthen pipeline discipline and CRM hygiene, ensuring opportunities are accurately tracked, properly qualified, consistently updated and supported by clear close plans, with key risks or gaps escalated to the Director of International Operations for oversight.
  • Develop and maintain commercial dashboards, reports and KPI tracking to provide visibility of pipeline health, forecast accuracy, conversion rates, deal velocity, revenue risk, market progress and sales performance.
  • Analyse pipeline movement, stalled opportunities, stage conversion, win/loss trends, sales cycle length and forecast variance, providing practical insights and feedback to the Director of International Operations, management and sales teams.
  • Prepare clear, structured decision-support materials, business cases and commercial analysis packs, ensuring recommendations are backed by data, logic, evidence and well-framed assumptions.
  • Work with Finance and commercial teams to improve the quality, consistency and credibility of commercial forecasts, deal models, pricing inputs, margin analysis, revenue assumptions and scenario planning.
  • Support pricing analysis, customer economics, commercial packaging and deal structure, helping assess whether opportunities are attractive, deliverable and aligned with VIOTAS’ strategic priorities, operational capability and margin expectations.
  • Support commercial governance and approval processes, by developing the commercial analysis, supporting evidence and decision materials required before commitments are made to customers or markets.
  • Analyse target markets, customer segments, competitor activity, pricing dynamics, service opportunities, customer value drivers and energy market trends to support market prioritisation, market-entry preparation, partnership assessment and account expansion.
  • Use AI tools and modern analytical methods to improve the speed, quality and scalability of commercial analysis, CRM insight, reporting, forecasting, market intelligence, business case development and decision support.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years’ experience in a commercial analyst, commercial finance, business analyst, or similar analytical role, ideally within energy, technology, infrastructure, industrial services or a scaling B2B environment.
  • Relevant third-level qualification in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, mathematics, energy systems or another commercially or quantitatively focused discipline.
  • Strong analytical and financial modelling capability, with advanced Excel skills and the ability to work confidently with CRM data, pipeline reports, pricing inputs, customer economics, margin analysis, revenue assumptions and imperfect commercial information.
  • Experience supporting pipeline management, CRM discipline, commercial reporting and sales performance analysis, including CRM hygiene, opportunity tracking, conversion analysis, forecast confidence, deal velocity and management reporting.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn complex data and commercial analysis into clear recommendations, executive-ready materials, dashboards and decision-support papers for senior stakeholders and sales

title: Research Assistant
description: Department: School of BusinessVacancy ID: 042663Closing Date: 19-Jul-2026We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Research Assistant (technical) to support a multidisciplinary technical team working on the EU Horizon-funded ADFLEX project. ADFLEX is a semantic translation bridge that breaks down data silos between local energy ecosystems (households, EVs, PVs) and Distribution System Operators (DSOs), standardising communication via the IEEE 2030.5 protocol.Working closely with experienced team members, the role will involve assisting in the development, testing, and refinement of a Python-based Small Language Model (SLM) for semantic data translation, integration of this data within the ENERSHARE Dataspace environment, and the development of APIs to expose translated data to DSOs. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate to gain hands-on experience across semantic web technologies, dataspace interoperability, and API development in the energy domain. The position requires strong analytical thinking, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced technical environment.Research Assistant L 1 (2026) Salary Scale: €34,134 per annum, pro rata (1 point )Closing Date23:30hrs (local Irish time) on Sunday 19th July 2026.Applications must be submitted by the closing date and time specified above. title: Research Technologist ResilientForests
description:
Location: Teagasc Mellows Campus, Athenry, Co Galway or other nominated location on agreement with the Head of Department

Technologist

Salary: Technologist Grade 1 with a Salary Scale of €42,921 to €81,218

Closing Date: 22/07/2026 12:00 PM

Funded Full Time



Job Summary

Duration:

Temporary externally funded non Grant-in-Aid contract post, the indicative duration of which is 24 months, subject to contract. A panel may be formed from which future similar vacancies may be filled; such a panel will remain active for a maximum period of 12 months.


Basic Function

A research technologist is required to contribute to the DAFM-funded ResilientForests project, which aims to develop diverse, productive and climate-resilient forests in Ireland through enhanced forest genetic resources, improved forest reproductive material, species diversification, wood quality assessment and microbiome-based solutions. The successful candidate will support research activities within the Forestry Development Department and contribute to generating practical knowledge and tools to support the long-term sustainability, resilience and productivity of Irish forests.

The primary focus of this role will be to support research on species mixtures involving Sitka spruce and other ecologically compatible tree species, with the objective of identifying stand compositions that improve forest resilience while maintaining productivity and timber quality. The research will assess the performance of mixed-species plantations containing Sitka spruce, using field measurements, forest inventory data and site information to evaluate their resilience potential under current and future environmental conditions.

Using data from the National Forest Inventory (NFI), existing forestry trials and newly collected field data, the successful candidate will help characterise and evaluate Sitka spruce mixtures established across Ireland. Species combinations of interest include Sitka spruce with Douglas fir, grand fir, western hemlock, noble fir, western red cedar, birch, and Norway spruce, based on established compatibility and silvicultural value (Kerr et al., 2020). The work will investigate productivity, biodiversity, resilience and timber quality outcomes associated with different mixture types, supporting evidence-based recommendations for future afforestation and forest management strategies.

The role will involve substantial field work across Ireland, including the assessment and monitoring of forestry sites on a range of soil types and environmental conditions. Responsibilities will include field data collection, database management, data analysis, preparation of technical reports, and contribution to scientific publications and project deliverables.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior research staff, postgraduate students and project partners, including researchers from Teagasc, UCD, TU Dublin, SETU, Coillte and industry stakeholders. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, teamwork and the ability to deliver project objectives are essential. The ability to communicate the research findings effectively to scientific, industry and stakeholder audiences will also be an important part of the role.


Background


Teagasc, the Agriculture and Food Development Authority, undertakes research, advisory and education activities in support of Ireland’s agri-food sector and wider bioeconomy. The Forestry Development Department provides integrated research, advisory and training programmes to support the sustainable development of forestry in Ireland.

The successful candidate will contribute to the ResilientForests project, a major national research initiative funded by the Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine (DAFM).

This is an exciting opportunity to build a wide range of experiences and help in the development of diverse, productive and climate-resilient forests in Ireland> It will focus on strengthening breeding strategies, enhancing forest genetic resources, improving forest reproductive material, and integrating wood quality and microbiome research to support future forest resilience, productivity and sustainability.

This is a research-focused role, providing excellent opportunities for the successful candidate to further develop their research, technical and analytical skills within a large multidisciplinary forestry research programme. Working closely with senior research staff, postgraduate students and project partners, the successful candidate will experience and contribute to field, laboratory and data-driven research activities across several project work packages.

The role will provide valuable experience in forestry research, project delivery, data management and analysis, preparation of scientific and technical reports, and contribution to or leading peer-reviewed publications. The successful candidate will also collaborate with researchers from Teagasc, UCD, TU Dublin, SETU Waterford, Coillte and other valued national and international partners, while developing communication, presentation and professional skills through participation in project meetings, workshops, stakeholder engagement activities and scientific conferences. Teagasc fully supports continuous professional development through appropriate induction, mentoring, training and learning opportunities relevant to the role and project objectives.

The post holder will also have opportunities to work alongside PhD, M.Res. and M.Sc. students associated with the project and contribute to a collaborative research environment foc

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Build quality into digital health from day one.

At Resmed, every line of code and every product decision has the potential to improve lives. As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you'll help ensure the reliability, quality, and performance of cloud-based digital health solutions that support people on their journey from sleep-health screening through diagnosis and treatment. Working within a collaborative engineering team focused on OSA Pathways, you'll drive test automation, improve release confidence, and help shape quality practices across web applications, APIs, cloud services, data flows, and CI/CD pipelines. This is an opportunity to combine strong engineering fundamentals with modern automation approaches, including responsible use of AI-assisted testing tools, while contributing to products that make healthcare more accessible and effective.

The role is offered as a hybrid position with 2–3 days per week onsite in our Dublin, Sandyford office.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain automated checks across web applications, APIs, backend services, and system integrations.
  • Build and enhance test automation frameworks using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Cucumber, or equivalent technologies.
  • Create risk-based smoke, regression, functional, and exploratory testing coverage for critical user journeys.
  • Validate workflows including assessment entry, questionnaire completion, eligibility outcomes, account creation, consent management, partner handoffs, reporting, and analytics events.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test generation, automation maintenance, and failure analysis while ensuring outputs are accurate, maintainable, and appropriate.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, architects, QA specialists, security, data, and support teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines so automated tests provide meaningful feedback during development, pull requests, releases, and production readiness activities.
  • Investigate defects, flaky tests, environment issues, integration failures, and data-related problems using logs, traces, screenshots, and reproducible evidence.
  • Support release readiness through regression planning, defect triage, testing activities, documentation, and risk communication.
  • Monitor automation coverage, identify gaps and duplication, and recommend improvements that strengthen product quality.
  • Participate in code reviews, test reviews, and architectural discussions with a focus on testability, reliability, observability, and user risk.
  • Help shape best practices for responsible AI usage within quality engineering.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding.
  • Professional experience in software testing, quality engineering, or software development in test.
  • Experience with both manual and automated testing approaches and the ability to apply the right level of testing based on risk.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated tests using Cypress, Playwright, Cucumber, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of web application testing, including browser behaviour, responsive design, accessibility fundamentals, validation, error handling, and end-to-end user journeys.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based architectures, ideally including AWS environments and associated services.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, and automated quality validation.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and agile development practices.
  • Ability to analyse defects, identify likely root causes, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Interest in AI-assisted testing and the responsible use of AI tools to improve quality engineering.
  • Understanding of data and analytics validation principles.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to analytics, funnel, event, or reporting validation.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools in cloud environments.

What Sets You Apart

  • Ownership Mindset – You take responsibility for quality outcomes and proactively address risks before they impact users.
  • Curiosity – You enjoy exploring how systems work, asking questions, and uncovering issues that others may overlook.
  • Balanced Judgement – You know when automation adds value and when human insight is essential.
  • Collaboration First – You work effectively across disciplines, building strong partnerships that improve the end product.
  • Continuous Improvement – You look for better ways of working and share practical knowledge that helps the team grow.
  • User Focus – You understand that behind every workflow and feature is a person relying on a dependable healthcare experience.

Additional information

  • At Resmed, all employees benefit from a bonus plan, the percentage of which depends on your position within the organisation

  • Competitive benefits

  • You also have access to a referral bonus and to Resmed's preferred shareholding programme

  • Internal career opportunity - joining an international fast-pace and massively growing company

title: Energy Engineer – (Solar PV & Wind)
description:
Location: Lissarda, Macroom, Co. Cork (20 minutes from Cork City link road)

Department: Project Design & Development

Contract: Full‑time, permanent

Company Overview

Enerco Energy Ltd is an independently owned Irish renewable energy company committed to the sustainable development of wind, solar and battery storage projects across Ireland and the UK. Our portfolio includes over 975 MW of wind generating capacity in commercial operation or under construction, with 500 MW in development, alongside a growing pipeline of solar PV and energy storage projects.

As the renewable energy sector continues to expand rapidly, we are growing our team and seeking a motivated individual to support the design and development of projects across all stages of the lifecycle from feasibility through to construction and operation.

Role Overview

This is an excellent opportunity to join one of Ireland's leading renewable energy developers. You will work closely with senior engineers and project managers, contributing to technical assessments, design work, planning applications, and project delivery for wind, solar and battery storage projects from early-stage feasibility through planning, design, construction and operation.

Key Responsibilities

· Site Feasibility Assessment — Evaluate potential sites for renewable energy development using CAD and GIS tools.

· Technical Project Support — Provide engineering input during project inception, development, pre‑construction and construction phases.

· Stakeholder Liaison — Engage with Local Authorities, consultants, landowners and contractors.

· Energy Yield Analysis — Conduct wind resource and energy yield assessments, including wake modelling and performance analysis using industry-standard and proprietary tools.

· Public Engagement — Assist in preparing materials for public information exhibitions and attend community meetings.

· Site Work — Participate in site surveys and walkovers.

· Engineering Drawings — Prepare site layout, planning, transport route and grid connection drawings.

· As‑Built Documentation — Support the preparation of design and as‑built drawings to EirGrid/ESBN standards.

· Project Delivery — Contribute to ad‑hoc project tasks and ensure high‑quality outputs.

Candidate Requirements

· A degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Renewable Energy, Geospatial Science, or a related discipline.

· Strong ability to collaborate within multidisciplinary teams and with external stakeholders.

· Competent in Microsoft Office, with working knowledge of CAD and GIS (training provided).

· Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills.

· Flexibility regarding travel and working hours when required.

· Previous experience is advantageous, but motivated recent graduates will also be considered.

· Full, clean driving licence.

What We Offer

· Comprehensive training and mentoring from experienced engineers.

· Training in industry-standard software including GIS, AutoCAD, wind resource assessment and energy yield modelling tools.

· Exposure to all stages of renewable energy project development.

· Opportunities for career progression in a rapidly expanding sector.

· Competitive remuneration aligned with experience.

· A supportive, collaborative working environment within a growing Irish company.

title: Electrical Capacity Install Technician , DCEO Capacity Install
description:
DESCRIPTION

We are currently seeking a Capacity Install Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations.
Due to the success of the Amazon’ operations and rapid expansion of Data Centres the suitable candidates will operate and maintain these facilities in Ireland. The successful candidates will be expected to have a primarily in the increase of capacity and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon’ customers better value.

Tasks:
  • Assist in the installation and operation of all racks and rack based systems .
  • Responding to daily changes and demands in installations particularly during peak periods. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
  • Assist in maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center rack systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.

title: Associate AWS Engineer
description:
Build cloud solutions that help people access better sleep health.

At Resmed, every line of code has the potential to improve lives. As an Associate AWS Engineer, you'll join a collaborative engineering team building cloud services that support OSA Pathways within our growing Digital Health business. Working from our hybrid Dublin office, you'll help develop secure, scalable backend services that support key stages of the patient journey—from sleep-health screening through diagnosis and treatment pathways.

This is an opportunity to grow your engineering career while working on meaningful products that connect patients, providers, partners, and healthcare systems. You'll contribute to modern AWS-based services, collaborate with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams, and gain hands-on experience building reliable software that supports real-world healthcare outcomes. If you're curious, motivated by learning, and excited about cloud technologies, you'll find plenty of opportunities to develop your skills while making a tangible impact.

The role is offered as a hybrid position with 2–3 days per week onsite in our Dublin, Sandyford office.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, test, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure backend software applications.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, architects, QA, security, and data teams to deliver solutions that meet business and user needs.
  • Contribute to cloud-based, serverless services supporting digital health products and workflows.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code aligned with team and industry best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, integration challenges, and performance issues.
  • Support the continuous improvement of development processes, delivery pipelines, observability practices, and release readiness activities.
  • Learn from experienced engineers while contributing to technical discussions, implementation decisions, and solution delivery.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline involving coding.
  • Working knowledge of Python and an understanding of object-oriented design principles.
  • Exposure to AWS services, particularly serverless technologies such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and CloudFront.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Understanding of RESTful API design, authentication and authorization concepts, including OAuth2 and JWT.
  • Understanding of microservices architecture principles.
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Comfort working in agile development environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.
  • A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for learning, growth, and knowledge sharing.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to message-brokering systems such as SQS or SNS and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to NoSQL and relational database technologies.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and monitoring or logging tools.
  • Experience developing modern web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript together with React.js and/or Next.js is a big plus.

What Sets You Apart

  • Growth Mindset – You actively seek opportunities to learn, develop new capabilities, and apply feedback to improve your work.
  • Collaborative Approach – You build strong relationships across teams and enjoy working together to solve complex challenges.
  • Ownership – You take responsibility for your contributions and follow through to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Curiosity – You ask thoughtful questions, explore new ideas, and embrace continuous improvement.
  • Problem-Solving Focus – You approach challenges with persistence and a practical mindset, helping move solutions forward.
  • Communication – You value clear, open communication that supports effective teamwork and better decision-making.

Additional information

  • At Resmed, all employees benefit from a bonus plan, the percentage of which depends on your position within the organisation

  • Competitive benefits

  • You also have access to a referral bonus and to Resmed's preferred shareholding programme

  • Internal career opportunity - joining an international fast-pace and massively growing company

We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. description:
Overview:

Who we are:

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With over 1,000 employees, in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles, we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defence, energy, and utilities. We fulfil this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the centre of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

CMMS Engineer role overview:


The CMMS Engineer is responsible for supporting the accuracy, integrity, and maintenance of asset and equipment data within Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS). Working within a structured project environment, this role performs equipment field verification, technical data reviews, and data preparation activities to support CMMS implementations, migrations, and ongoing system maintenance. The CMMS Engineer collaborates with project managers, technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure asset information is accurate, complete, and aligned with established data standards. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical, technical, and organizational skills and will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance maintenance and asset management processes.


This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates seeking direct employment as well as experienced self-employed contractors. The engagement model will be discussed with suitable candidates during the recruitment process. This is a remote-based role with occasional travel to customer sites and company locations as required (typically less than 10%).

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Perform field walkdowns to verify the accuracy and completeness of equipment and asset information prior to entry into the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Review, validate, and enter technical asset and maintenance data into CMMS platforms while ensuring compliance with established data standards and project requirements.
  • Translate, cleanse, and prepare raw equipment and maintenance data for system migration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance activities.
  • Support data migration projects by reviewing legacy system data, identifying discrepancies, and assisting with the accurate transfer of asset information into the CMMS.
  • Assist in the preparation of project documentation and client status reports while tracking assigned tasks against project timelines.
  • Communicate data discrepancies, project risks, or delays to the Project Manager and support timely resolution of identified issues.
  • Collaborate with engineers, technicians, and client stakeholders to collect equipment information, validate asset data, and support successful CMMS implementation activities.
  • Participate in stakeholder meetings to communicate project progress, discuss changes, and support change management initiatives throughout project execution.
  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and other data management tools to organize, validate, and analyse asset and maintenance data.
  • Extract and analyse CMMS data using business intelligence and reporting tools to support operational reporting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and business decision-making.
  • Provide first-line support to CMMS users by assisting with system navigation, responding to user queries, and maintaining asset and equipment records.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on CMMS optimization, asset data quality, and maintenance processes.
  • Maintain accurate documentation relating to asset data, system updates, and project activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:

Experience and Key Competencies:

  • An associate or bachelor's degree, or trade certification, in Engineering, Maintenance, Asset Management, or a related technical discipline. Relevant industry experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.
  • At least one year of experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems, maintenance systems, or asset management data.
  • Experience supporting CMMS implementations, data migration projects, or maintenance data management activities is desirable.
  • Strong computer proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel, with the ability to organize and maintain technical datasets.
  • Familiarity with maintenance, calibration, asset management, or engineering documentation processes.

title: Associate Regulatory Affairs Specialist - ICT
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Medtronic

At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.

Our Purpose

At our Regulatory Affairs department in Medtronic, plc, based in Galway our mission is to develop innovative strategies for regulatory approval, anticipate and respond to changing regulatory requirements, and provide strategic leadership to influence the global regulatory environment to benefit the patients we serve. Regulatory Affairs is a key function within the business and this role is supporting the Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) operating unit.

Come for a job, stay for a career!

A Day in The Life Of:

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Supports or performs coordination and preparation of document packages for regulatory submissions.

  • Teams with other Regulatory Affair Specialists and International regulatory Specialists to provide regulatory support for changes to existing products.

  • Work with engineers and technical experts to develop robust regulatory strategies and resolve questions from regulatory agencies.

  • Leads or compiles all materials required in submissions, license renewal and annual registrations.

  • Supports change control activities to support global approval and implementation of product and process changes.

  • Recommends changes for labeling, manufacturing, marketing, and clinical protocol/evaluation reports for regulatory compliance.

  • Keeps abreast of regulatory procedures and changes. Develop internal procedures to ensure continuous compliance with all regulatory requirements.

  • May direct interaction with regulatory agencies on defined matters.

  • Support regulatory compliance activities, including manufacturing site registration & GMP audits as needed.

  • Monitors and improves tracking / control systems.

  • Identifies and develops best practices within the Regulatory Affairs Department including continuous development initiatives and hyperautomation.

Key Skills & Experience

  • We are looking for a person qualified to Level 8 Science or Engineering bachelor’s degree. A Regulatory Affairs qualification is desirable, but not mandatory.

  • 0 – 1 years regulatory experience in Medical Devices and/or Pharmaceuticals or Software in medical devices is required.

  • You are a dynamic team player and can work effectively and pro-actively on activities both individually and in teams.

  • You have strong technical knowledge. You are skilled in thinking critically and making sound decisions.

  • You collaborate with others and create alignment with team members.

title: Energy Engineer
description:
About Encon

Encon, a leading Building, Retrofit & Renewables Contractor in the South East of Ireland, is continuing its expansion and now seeks a talented Commercial Energy Engineer to join our dynamic team. With a strong focus on energy retrofitting, sustainability, new build developments, and commercial façade projects, Encon offers long-term job security.

If you want to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of energy-efficient construction while enjoying strong work–life balance and career growth, this opportunity is for you.

The Role

As Commercial Energy Engineer, you will take our commercial and community energy projects from first client engagement right through to handover for delivery.

You will play an active part in winning work — supported by the technical expertise of our Managing Director and the assistance of our office and sales support team — and then take full ownership of each project: carrying out the energy audit and assessment, developing the upgrade design, managing grant funding applications, handling procurement and contracts, and acting as the client's main point of contact, right through to a clean handover to our delivery Project Manager.

Where it makes sense to sub-contract a specialist energy audit, you will source and manage that input; otherwise, every stage sits with you. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role for someone who enjoys both the commercial side of converting a client and the technical satisfaction of seeing a project through to completion.

Our projects span a range of sectors — including community groups, businesses, hospitality, education, and transport and logistics — so you will work across a varied mix of building types and client needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the sales process — preparing and presenting proposals, advising on technical solutions, and helping convert opportunities — working alongside the Managing Director and our office and sales support team.
  • Take full ownership of each project once won, managing it through to handover for delivery.
  • Conduct energy audits and on-site assessments — or, where appropriate, source and manage a sub-contracted specialist — to establish each building's performance and upgrade potential.

Essential Requirements

  • The ability to carry out commercial energy assessments — through Non-Domestic (Commercial) BER Assessor registration with SEAI and/or proven experience delivering SSEA energy audits.
  • Demonstrable experience across the project lifecycle — including design, procurement and contract management — on construction, retrofit or energy projects.
  • Strong understanding of energy efficiency measures, building fabric and renewable technologies (solar PV, heat pumps, insulation, ventilation and similar).
  • Full, clean driving licence and willingness to travel to client sites.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in plain language.
  • Confident using energy assessment software and standard office tools.
  • Carry out Commercial (Non-Domestic) BER assessments and/or SSEA energy audits, and use the findings to inform the upgrade strategy.
  • Develop clear, practical energy upgrade designs and specifications.
  • Prepare and manage grant funding applications on behalf of clients, including SEAI grant schemes and Above the Shop funding supports.
  • Manage procurement by way of liaising with our measurement & estimating department for sourcing, tendering, evaluating and selecting suppliers and sub-contractors, and securing materials and equipment.
  • Manage contracts and project documentation, keeping cost, scope and programme under control.
  • Act as the client's main point of contact from first engagement through the design, funding and procurement phases.
  • Co-ordinate a clean, well-documented handover to the delivery Project Manager.
  • Stay current on funding schemes, grant rates, eligibility criteria and relevant regulatory changes.

Desirable — A Strong Advantage

  • Experience preparing or managing SEAI grant applications and/or Above the Shop funding applications.

Personal Attributes

  • Takes ownership — comfortable being accountable for a project from first engagement through to handover.
  • Confident with clients — able to build trust and help win work in a consultative setting, with support from the wider team.
  • Highly organised — able to manage scope, cost, programme and funding deadlines without losing accuracy.
  • Detail-oriented and precise — essential for assessments, designs, contracts and grant applications.
  • Commercially aware — with sound judgement around proposals, procurement, suppliers and contracts.
  • Analytically capable — comfortable interpreting energy data and translating it into clear recommendations.
  • A confident communicator — able to present, explain and keep clients informed and reassured throughout.
  • Collaborative — works well with the Managing Director, sales support team, delivery Project Manager and sub-contractors.
  • Experience in technical or consultative sales within construction, energy or a related field.
  • A relevant qualification — for example in renewable energy, building services engineering, energy management, construction, environmental science or sustainability.
  • Knowledge of NZEB standards, Part F, L & V of the Building Regulations and retrofit best practice.
  • LEED accreditation (e.g. LEED Green Associate or AP), or experience delivering projects to LEED standards — an advantage, not essential.
  • Project management experien

description:

Veta Virtual is hiring a Junior Web Developer for one of our high-growth clients in the Digital Marketing industry — an award-winning, fully remote SEO agency specializing in the automotive vertical. This is a hands-on, learning-focused role built for someone who is technically solid, eager to grow, and energized by the idea of making a real impact on client websites every single day. If you are a motivated developer who takes pride in clean code, thrives in a collaborative remote environment, and wants to sharpen your skills inside a fast-moving agency — this role was made for you.

As a Junior Web Developer, you will work directly in support of the SEO and Content departments — managing, updating, and maintaining client websites across a growing portfolio of automotive dealership accounts.   • Managing and overseeing client websites — ensuring they are current, technically accurate, and optimized for performance and search visibility at all times.

  • 1+ year of related web development experience and/or a completed coding bootcamp — you have real hands-on experience, not just classroom theory.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills — you collaborate clearly with remote teammates and ask the right questions when needed.
  • A genuine willingness to learn, adapt, and grow — this agency moves fast, loves to test, and rewards curiosity. You should too.
  • Strong attention to detail — small errors on client websites have real consequences and you take accuracy seriously.

  • Bonus: experience with WordPress or other Content Management Systems.
  • Bonus: basic understanding of SEO principles and how web development decisions impact search performance.
  • Bonus: basic understanding of automotive brands, models, and dealership industry context.
  • Bonus: experience working with remote teams in an agency environment.
  • To be considered for this role, you must be currently based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary in USD — paid consistently every month, no matter where you are.
  • 10 paid vacation days per year plus all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe with a professional home setup.
  • Tremendous room for growth — inside a fast-growing, award-winning digital marketing agency where your technical skills will be challenged, expanded, and genuinely valued every day.
  • A collaborative, supportive culture through Veta Virtual and our client — where learning, experimentation, and quality are part of how the team operates from day one.

Ready to Apply?

If you are ready to sharpen your development skills, contribute to real client results, and grow inside one of the most innovative digital marketing agencies in the automotive space — apply now and launch your next chapter with Veta Virtual!

Once you apply, you will be invited to complete a short 2-minute video question as part of our screening process. It is your first opportunity to show us your technical thinking, your communication style, and what makes you the right person for this role. We can't wait to meet you!

Company Description


WELCOME TO MARS CAPITAL

Mars Capital Finance Ireland DAC (“Mars Capital”) is part of Arrow Global Group Limited, which is one of Europe’s leading integrated asset managers with €112bn Assets Under Management (“AUM”) and 4,400 employees across five jurisdictions

Mars Capital was established in 2015 and is a Regulated Credit Servicing Firm, authorised by the Central Bank of Ireland and located in Dublin 2. Mars Capital has the capacity and regulatory authority to service loans secured against properties and has €8bn AUM, experiencing significant growth in recent years. We value our relationship with our clients and believe that our deployment of dedicated, Dublin-based project and asset management teams give us a competitive advantage over other competitors who operate a shared services model across their portfolios. Placing the customer first in a simple and efficient manner in line with our regulatory obligation is our number one priority.

Our local strategic ambition is to provide value accretive services to institutional clients, while building better financial futures for our customers, clients, communities and colleagues.


Our Culture and Way of Working

We’re entrepreneurial, fast-paced and decisive, working together safely and supportively. We trust our colleagues to make the right decisions and are brave enough to acknowledge mistakes and to learn from them. Celebrating success, we reward those who help us to achieve exceptional long-term results.

We’re inclusive and encourage our colleagues to be themselves. Our culture supports the difference that makes each of us unique. We’re open and eager to embrace new ways of working and have a diverse community, enriched by local identities that works collaboratively to build a unified and dynamic organisation.

We believe that a supported flexible working approach helps us to retain valued colleagues, enhance wellbeing, increase motivation and encourage a healthy work/life balance. If you’re interviewed, ask about the flexibility involved in this role.


Our Values

Our stakeholders expect us to act in an ethical and responsible way and this is at the heart of how we conduct our business. description:

CSA Engineer

About Us

Arcadis is the worlds leading company in sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy for natural and built assets. With over 36,000 professionals in 70+ countries, we are united in improving quality of life and solving the worlds most complex challenges.

Location/s: Based in our Little Island, Cork offices.

Role description

Role description:

Reporting to the CSA Department Manager, the CSA Engineer will be a member of the CSA Department supporting the delivery of civil, structural and architectural design services for major pharmaceutical and industrial clients. The role will primarily focus on civil engineering design, including urban drainage systems, roads, site development, earthworks and underground services coordination.

The successful candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams, assisting in the delivery of projects from concept through detailed design and construction. The post-holder will be motivated to develop their technical and project delivery skills within a dynamic and fast-paced environment while contributing to the successful delivery of high-quality engineering solutions.

The CSA Engineer will work closely with Architects, Structural Engineers and other discipline teams to ensure designs are coordinated, compliant and delivered to programme. The post-holder is expected to demonstrate the Arcadis Core Values at all times.



Key Responsibilities



  • Interface with client design teams and project stakeholders as required.
  • Support delivery of design scope within budget and schedule.
  • Prepare engineering calculations, reports, specifications and design documentation.
  • Design and coordinate urban drainage systems, roads, site infrastructure and underground services.
  • Participate in technical, safety and compliance reviews.
  • Support BC(A)R compliance activities where required.
  • Coordinate design activities with other disciplines.
  • Identify and communicate technical issues that may impact quality, cost or schedule.
  • Attend and contribute to design and site meetings as required.
  • Undertake site visits during construction and support resolution of technical queries.
  • Work towards project schedules and target deadlines.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental procedures, checklists and guidelines.
  • Committed to the promotion of Arcadis Behavioural Standards, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion.

Other reasonable work as requested by the CSA Department Manager & Operations Director(s)


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Minimum 8 years post graduate experience in the Industrial, Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences and Bio-pharma sectors, Candidates should have a third level qualification in the relevant discipline (Civil / Structural Engineering).
  • A member of recognised professional body  MIEI or MIStructE.
  • In depth knowledge of Statutory Consent Processes, Building Regulations and BC(A)R process is essential.
  • Demonstrable design, technical and construction knowledge is essential for this role.
  • Strong detailing, design development and tender pack assembly experience.
  • Experience in leading a design team and coordinating the other team members.
  • Specialist experience in key technical areas to include but not limited to OSD, Filling suites, packaging area requirements, cleanroom layouts & laboratory design experience desirable with good knowledge of utility requirements.
  • Strong working knowledge of civil design, structural design, and analysis software such as Revit, Tekla (or equivalent).


Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. Its why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

Youll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, youll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

Were dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone thrives. Through six ED&I workstreamsAge, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+, and Racewe foster innovation by embracing diverse perspectives.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Seamus Byrne Electrical Ltd

Seamus Byrne Electrical Ltd is an industry-leading provider of commercial and industrial electrical services, delivering high-quality electrical installations and solutions to clients across Ireland. Due to continued growth and expansion, we are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Junior Project Engineer to join our team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recently qualified electrician or graduate engineer who is looking to transition into a project engineering and management role while continuing to develop their technical knowledge and professional career.

The Role

Working closely with our experienced Project Management Team, you will gain hands-on experience in the planning, coordination and delivery of commercial and industrial electrical projects. The role is primarily office-based, with regular visits to project sites throughout Ireland.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • A qualification as an electrician or a recent qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Excellent organisational and communication skills.

  • Training, PPE and H&S documentation: Maintain staff training records, PPE logs, and all Health & Safety documentation
  • New staff onboarding: Coordinate new employee inductions and ensure all required documentation is completed
  • Purchasing and logistics support: Prepare purchase requisitions for goodsin and interbranch transport tasks; follow up on outstanding orders
  • Weekly lorry documentation: Manage all paperwork associated with the weekly delivery received from head office
  • Other duties as required: The role will evolve as the business grows, and additional responsibilities will be assigned over time


Required skills and competencies;

  • Organisation and time management: Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines
  • Communication skills: Clear, professional communication with customers, staff, and suppliers
  • Attention to detail: Strong accuracy in data entry, documentation, and recordkeeping
  • Problemsolving: Ability to identify issues and resolve them proactively
  • IT proficiency: Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, HR / timekeeping systems, and general office software
  • Confidentiality and discretion: Ability to handle sensitive staff and business information appropriately
  • Team collaboration: Works well with colleagues across departments and supports wider operational goals


Experience and Qualifications:

  • Experience in an administrative, operations, or coordination role (1-3 years preferred)
  • Experience with HR systems, timekeeping software, or workforce management tools is an advantage
  • Knowledge of Health and Safety, training records, or compliance documentation is beneficial
  • Experience in logistics, goodsin processes, or order management is desirable
  • As the role expands, there may be opportunities to support basic accounts or invoicing tasks. Prior exposure to accounts processes is beneficial


Personal Attributes:

  • Proactive and selfmotivated
  • Reliable and consistent
  • Professional and approachable
  • Flexible and adaptable as the role grows
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability


Compensation Package:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • CPD accredited employer

title: Data Analyst 2
description:

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.


Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny offices and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Support engineers and business users of Individual and Family Plans (IFP) PCOR reporting applications

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or proven experience in a relevant field
  • Proven experience working with relational data and SQL programming (SQL Server, Teradata, or similar databases)
  • Proven experience in a QA role - testing, analyzing and validating data
  • Proven experience in data processing involving data movement between various servers (SQL/Snowflake/Hive), working with text files, and other data sources
  • Experience of business intelligence solutions and architecture (Power BI, Tableau or similar)
  • Experience with the software development life cycle (i.e. Business Requirements, Technical Documentation, Quality Assurance)
  • Self-guided in terms of understating data in physical tables or views, and ability to create/ enhance stored procedures or functions pertaining to report feeds, or any input/output

  • Ability to perform system investigation, reverse engineering, and new development while adhering to development standards and good change control practices

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Python and Snowflake
  • Experience in Healthcare, Financial Services, or Insurance Industry
  • Experience with automating ETL package
  • Knowledge of US Healthcare and Medicare
  • Solid communication skills with experience presenting ideas and solutions to business customers


Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.


At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. title: Data Analyst (FinCrime)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists ‌work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to contribute to the fight against money laundering, terrorism financing, fraud, and sanctions. You'll set the indicators and dashboards to monitor our overall FinCrime framework, and contribute to specific investigations mandated by authorities.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Developing data reporting requirements for Banque de France and new data reporting for the European Anti-Money Laundering Authority
  • Investigating financial crime data analytics from internal projects or requests from authorities
  • Defining and implementing key risk indicators and overseeing their maintenance
  • Collaborating with MLROs, 1LoD, and 2LoD FinCrime teams, as well as Risk stakeholders
  • Leading end-to-end analysis, from conceptualisation to visualisation and presentation
  • Applying an understanding and knowledge of data to help Product and Support teams
  • Designing key metrics to measure different aspects of the business
  • Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
  • Maintaining and creating dashboards to track metrics and visualise insights

What you'll need

  • Knowledge of financial crime concepts/data
  • Experience in an analytical role creating impactful solutions
  • A background/education in a quantitative discipline
  • Great skills with SQL, Python, or another programming language
  • Experience in financial services or banking
  • Evidence of solid mathematical and statistics knowledge

Nice to have

  • An advanced degree in a core STEM subject
  • Experience with additional programming languages, such as Java, Scala, or C++
  • To have participated in school/University Olympic medal competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, or Power BI

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

FIS Integrity -Treasury and Risk Management System Support Analyst with 2 Level experience.

Our Client is in the process of implementing a global rollout of FIS Integrity Treasury and Risk Management System.

Must have at least 3 to 5 years experience at supporting 1st / 2nd Line Treasury systems or financial systems support

The Client is ideally looking to recruit at least 1 years experience of working with and supporting FIS Treasury and Risk Management System FIS Integrity.

This is a 2 level Treasury Systems implementation and support position.

The role involves providing second-line technical support for FIS Integrity and related treasury systems, including diagnosing incidents, resolving complex issues, and escalating to vendors or internal teams when needed.

The analyst will monitor system performance, manage service requests, document solutions, and contribute to improvements in system reliability and user experience.

Day-to-day tasks include working closely with treasury, IT, and operations stakeholders, handling changes and configuration updates, and ensuring adherence to service-level and security standards.

The role requires clear communication with users, accurate reporting on incidents and trends, and proactive identification of risks or optimization opportunities.

Qualifications

Have solid Analytical Skills and Information Technology knowledge, including understanding of system architecture, interfaces, and incident analysis.

Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across teams.

Experience in treasury, banking, or financial services environments and familiarity with ITIL or similar service management frameworks is beneficial.

A relevant degree or professional qualification in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, along with experience in hybrid working setups, is preferred.

Incident Management & Treasury Service Continuity

? Log, classify, and prioritise incidents in ServiceNow based on Treasury business impact

? Perform structured triage and initial diagnosis

? Resolve standard issues within SLA using approved knowledge base and runbooks

? Escalate complex or cross?system issues to L3 with full technical and business diagnostic context

? Support major incident management processes and incident bridge calls

Cash, Position & Exposure Data Integrity

Ensures integrity of cash, position, risk, exposure, and hedge data used in Treasury decision?making, external reporting, and audit processes.

? Validate transaction, position, balance, and exposure data across Treasury systems

? Identify and resolve discrepancies impacting liquidity confidence and risk accuracy

Support reconciliation processes and ensure audit?ready completeness of financial data

Testing & Release Support with Treasury Assurance

Ensures Treasury readiness and outcome protection for system changes and SaaS releases.

? Support execution of business testing, UAT, and regression testing

? Validate operational outputs resulting from system changes

? Assist in business readiness checks prior to release or cutover

Essential

? 2?5 years? experience in 1st / 2nd Line Treasury systems or financial systems support

? Understanding of Treasury processes (payments, liquidity, settlements)

? Experience with incident management and ITIL processes

Desirable

A proactive attitude and ability to adapt to a hybrid work environment

This will be a hybrid role with 3 days in the office in Dublin Ireland.

The salary for this role will be in the range £70K - £85K.

Do send your CV to us in Word format along with your salary and availability.
